As of this profiling the company exposes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API specifications; this profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched with a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: FeezBack
providers.description: FeezBack is an Israeli open-banking fintech, founded in 2016, that builds the technological infrastructure and consumer products enabling financial players to compete in Israel's open-banking ecosystem. Its products cover account-to- account payment initiation (direct bank payments with no card-processing fees integrated into sales and point-of-sale flows), aggregated financial data for underwriting and risk assessment, and financial analysis for investment portfolio and risk allocation. FeezBack holds a Bank of Israel financial information service provider (AIS) license and a payment initiation (PIS) approval, and is ISO 27001 certified for information security. The company describes an API-based integration model for partners but publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: Gecko Robotics
providers.description: Gecko Robotics is a Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania based AI and robotics company that inspects and manages critical physical infrastructure. Its wall-climbing, aerial and submersible robots capture full-coverage ultrasonic, visual and other sensor readings from boilers, pressure vessels, tanks, pipelines, ship hulls and decks, which are fused with facility records and operational data inside Cantilever, the company's AI-powered operating platform for the built world. Cantilever quantifies corrosion rates, predicts remaining asset life and prioritizes capital and maintenance decisions for customers across defense, power, oil and gas, steel, pulp and paper, mining and advanced manufacturing. Cantilever is delivered as a closed, authenticated enterprise SaaS at cantilever.app; Gecko Robotics publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs or self-serve API program, and integrations are arranged through the company directly.

providers.name: Long-Term Stock Exchange
providers.description: The Long-Term Stock Exchange (LTSE) is a U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission-registered national securities exchange headquartered in New York, built to support companies and investors committed to long-term value creation. LTSE operates a principles-based equities trading platform that accepts order entry over the MEMO FIX and MEMO SBE (Simple Binary Encoding) protocols and distributes real-time market data - depth of book, top of book, and last sale - via the MEMOIR multicast feed. Beyond the exchange it offers private-markets and cap-table software plus long-term listing standards. LTSE does not publish a public REST/OpenAPI developer API; participant connectivity (Direct, Extranet, Telco via NY4) and technical specifications are provided through its Market Operations team.

providers.name: DoorFeed
providers.description: DoorFeed is a technology-led residential real estate investment platform, founded in 2021 and headquartered in Paris, that helps institutional investors, funds, and family offices source and manage single-family rental portfolios at scale across the UK and France. The platform ingests roughly 150,000 new property listings and over 1,000,000 property images every day, structuring market data, comparable transactions, valuation signals, and energy-performance data into a single acquisition and asset-management workflow that takes investors from market screening to investment decision in minutes. DoorFeed is backed by HV Capital, Seedcamp, and Motive Partners. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead and enriched by the pipeline; DoorFeed publishes no public API or developer program at this time.

providers.name: Farther
providers.description: Farther is a technology-driven wealth management and registered investment advisory (RIA) firm that pairs human financial advisors with a proprietary "Intelligent Wealth Platform." The firm has recruited more than $23 billion in client assets and positions itself among the fastest-growing US financial services firms (Inc. Magazine, Deloitte Technology Fast 500). Services span financial and retirement planning, investment and portfolio management, tax-intelligent optimization, trust and estate planning, generational wealth, small-business services, Farther Asset Management, and institutional offerings. The client experience runs through a single-page web/mobile application at app.farther.com and integrates account aggregation via Plaid. Farther does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDKs, or a developer portal; this profile captures the firm's public web, security, and identity surface. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Lightspeed Venture Partners.

providers.name: Raymond James Bank
providers.description: Raymond James Bank is a Florida-chartered state member bank headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, and a wholly owned subsidiary of Raymond James Financial, Inc. (NYSE: RJF), a diversified financial services holding company founded in 1962. Supervised by the Federal Reserve and the Florida Office of Financial Regulation, the bank provides securities-based lending, residential mortgages, commercial and industrial and commercial real estate loans, tax-exempt loans, and deposit products (including its Enhanced Savings Program) primarily to Raymond James wealth-management and institutional clients. On open finance, the bank runs no first-party public developer portal and publishes no downloadable API specifications; consumer-permissioned account data is reachable only indirectly through third-party aggregators such as Plaid. No FDX participation or CFPB Section 1033 data-access posture is publicly documented for this institution as of this record.

providers.name: Blend Financial
providers.description: Blend Financial Inc., doing business as Origin Financial (useorigin.com), is a consumer wealth management and personal finance platform that unifies income, net worth, spending, investments, assets, and liabilities into a single application. Origin pairs AI-powered budgeting and spend tracking with investment tools, estate and tax planning, and access to CFP professional advice; investment advisory services are provided through Origin Investment Advisory LLC, a subsidiary of Blend Financial Inc. The company is a consumer (B2C) product backed by 500 Global, Felicis Ventures, Founders Fund, and other investors, and also offers employer-sponsored financial wellness. As surfaced in the API Evangelist network it is a company profile; Origin publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation at this time.

providers.name: BrightPlan
providers.description: BrightPlan is a San Jose, California based financial wellness company that sells a Total Financial Wellness platform to enterprise HR and benefits teams, combining a self-service digital financial planning application, an AI-powered financial wellness coach, and access to human CFP fiduciary advisors. BrightPlan LLC is an SEC-registered investment adviser, and the product is delivered to employees as an employer-sponsored benefit rather than as a self-serve consumer subscription. The employee experience runs at my.brightplan.com and web.brightplan.com with iOS and Android apps; employer value is framed around benefits engagement, retention, and measurable financial wellbeing. BrightPlan markets HRIS and benefits-system integration to employers but publishes no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: Nutmeg (J.P. Morgan Personal Investing)
providers.description: Nutmeg is a UK digital wealth manager and robo-advisor founded in 2011 and acquired by JPMorgan Chase in 2021, now operating as J.P. Morgan Personal Investing. It offers consumer investment accounts including Stocks and Shares ISAs, Lifetime ISAs, Junior ISAs, personal pensions, and general investment accounts, with fully managed, Smart Alpha, socially responsible, thematic, fixed allocation, and income portfolio strategies plus free financial guidance and paid advice. Nutmeg is authorised and regulated by the UK Financial Conduct Authority (FCA register #552016). It is a consumer-facing wealth platform and does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Plum
providers.description: Plum is a UK-based personal finance "money app" that helps consumers save and invest automatically. Its mobile app pairs automated savings algorithms (eight saving automations) with a range of regulated products including Easy Access Savings, a Cash ISA, a 95-day Notice Account, a money-market Interest pocket, a Stocks & Shares ISA, a Self-Invested Personal Pension (SIPP), and access to thousands of stocks and funds. Plum operates under FCA oversight through multiple entities covering payment services, e-money, investment broking, and account information services, and monetizes via subscription tiers (Basic, Plus, Boost, Max). It is a consumer-facing product with no public developer API; this profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and Partech and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: One
providers.description: OnePay (formerly One / One Finance) is a Walmart-backed consumer fintech that delivers a single mobile app combining banking, high-yield savings, a CashRewards debit card, a credit-building card, buy-now-pay-later, investing, cryptocurrency trading, and tax filing. Banking services are provided through partner banks Coastal Community Bank and Lead Bank (Members FDIC). The product is consumer-facing with no public developer API; a partner/developer portal exists behind authentication at developer.onepay.com. Originally surfaced as a portfolio company of Obvious Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead for enrichment.

providers.name: OurCrowd
providers.description: OurCrowd is a global private-market investment platform that gives accredited and institutional investors access to curated venture and alternative-asset deals. Through a single online account, members can invest in pre-vetted startups, thematic and targeted venture funds, and a range of alternatives such as private equity and private credit. The platform handles deal sourcing, due diligence, syndication, and post-investment management. OurCrowd is a consumer-facing investment product and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation; this profile captures its public identity and web surface.

providers.name: Plural Ai
providers.description: Plural is an AI platform built for private markets professionals across private debt, private equity, and banking. Its AI agents ingest and analyze complex financial documents and data-room sources (documents, SharePoint, data rooms) to generate auditable, fully-referenced outputs — deal screeners, investment committee (IC) memos, term-sheet drafts, portfolio reports, and compliance documentation. Plural emphasizes EU data residency, end-to-end encryption, ISO 27001-aligned controls, and GDPR/DORA readiness, with no training on customer data. The company is backed by Speedinvest, Creative Destruction Lab, AI SEED, Innovate UK, and the European Commission. As of this enrichment pass no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface is published; the product references MCP and agent integrations for private-markets workflows.

providers.name: Pylon (formerly Braid Lending)
providers.description: Pylon (formerly Braid Lending) is an AI-native mortgage infrastructure company founded in 2022 and headquartered in New York, New York, backed by investors including 500 Global and Citi. Pylon operates as "America's mortgage rails," an API-first, MCP-native platform that lets brokers, fintechs, lenders, and banks build and automate mortgage origination end to end — from application through underwriting, decisioning, compliance, and capital markets settlement. Every aspect of mortgage fulfillment is powered by APIs, complemented by a white-label "Elements" UI component library for embedding fully digital, autonomous mortgage experiences. The public developer surface (API reference, integration guides, and a live playground) is gated behind a developer-access request form, so no public OpenAPI, SDKs, or hosted docs were discoverable during enrichment.

providers.name: UBS Bank USA
providers.description: UBS Bank USA (BUSA) is a Utah state-chartered industrial bank and FDIC-insured depository institution headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah, established in 2003 and reporting roughly $122 billion in total assets. It is the primary US banking vehicle of UBS Wealth Management Americas, providing FDIC-insured deposit sweep programs, securities-based lending, mortgages, and credit cards almost exclusively to the high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth advisory clients of parent UBS Group AG. It is supervised by the FDIC, the Utah Department of Financial Institutions, and the CFPB. Unlike a fintech or a Banking-as-a-Service provider, UBS Bank USA exposes no first-party public developer API surface of its own; its services are delivered through UBS Financial Advisors rather than self-serve APIs. The only live UBS developer portal (developer.ubs.com) belongs to UBS Switzerland and serves Swiss and EU products (key4 mortgages, QR-bill, PSD2, TWINT, bLink, KeyPort/EBICS), not this US entity. US consumer-permissioned data access, where available, is mediated by third-party aggregators rather than a documented BUSA API.

providers.name: UNest
providers.description: UNest is a Los Angeles-based fintech app that helps parents and families save and invest for their children's futures through UTMA/UGMA custodial investment accounts, with brand rewards contributions, gifting, financial literacy content, and term life insurance offered through Ladder. UNest Advisers, LLC is an SEC-registered investment adviser, with brokerage through UNest Securities, LLC (FINRA/SIPC) and clearing through Apex Clearing. The company is a consumer mobile-app business and publishes no public developer API, though its site ships a real llms.txt. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Endowus
providers.description: Endowus is a Singapore- and Hong Kong-based digital wealth management platform founded in 2017 by Gregory Van and Samuel Rhee. It gives retail, accredited, and private-wealth clients access to low-fee institutional share-class funds, advised and self-directed portfolios, and private-market and alternatives strategies across Cash, CPF (Central Provident Fund), and SRS (Supplementary Retirement Scheme) accounts. Its conflict-free model rebates 100% of trailer fees and fund-manager commissions to clients. Endowus is licensed by the Monetary Authority of Singapore (CMS License 101051), serves 300,000+ clients, and manages over US$10 billion in assets. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead; the company operates consumer apps but publishes no public developer API or documentation at this time.

providers.name: RentSpree
providers.description: RentSpree is a Los Angeles-headquartered rental real estate technology platform that streamlines the long-tail rental transaction for real estate agents, landlords, property managers, and renters. Its consumer-facing product suite covers online rental applications, TransUnion-powered tenant screening (credit, background, eviction, and income verification), e-sign and lease workflows, ACH/card rent payments, AI-assisted listing pages and syndication, rent estimate, and renters insurance. RentSpree positions itself as the rental layer for the MLS and brokerage ecosystem and has built named integrations with Multiple Listing Services (Bright MLS, CRMLS, Beaches MLS, CJMLS, Florida Realtors) and PropTech partners (SkySlope, Lone Wolf, ZipLogix, C.A.R. OnlineEd). It also runs an Enterprise API Integration program for MLSs, associations, brokerages, and PropTech vendors that want to embed rental application intake and tenant screening into their own platforms — documentation is not publicly published; partners are onboarded through a sales/integration process with implementation quoted at as little as three weeks. There is no self-serve developer portal, no public OpenAPI specification, and no public SDK or CLI; the RentSpree GitHub org is effectively empty (only a .github org-defaults repo). RentSpree is SOC 2 Type II certified and reports more than four million agents, landlords, and renters on the platform.

providers.name: Delphia
providers.description: Delphia (Delphia Technologies Inc., Toronto, Canada) is an AI-driven quantitative investment firm that puts alternative data to work in systematic trading strategies. Originally a consumer robo-advisor and data-reward token platform backed by a $60M Series A led by Multicoin Capital, Delphia pivoted in 2024 to institutional quant investing with its Oracle Alpha hedge fund and Tilt trend platform. As of this writing Delphia publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures the company identity plus its live security and well-known surfaces.

providers.name: GraniteShares
providers.description: GraniteShares is an independent exchange-traded fund (ETF) issuer that builds alternative, single-stock and thematic investment products for investors who want differentiated exposure. Its lineup spans 2x leveraged and inverse single-stock ETFs (such as NVDL for NVIDIA and TSLR for Tesla), YieldBOOST options-income ETFs, autocallable ETFs, physically-backed gold and broad commodity ETFs, and diversified income and equity strategies across U.S. and European markets. GraniteShares publishes no public developer or data API program; this API Evangelist profile catalogs the company's public web surface and the machine-readable discovery documents (OpenID Connect / OAuth 2.0 member authentication for its Umbraco-powered site) that were probed from its domain. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bain Capital Ventures.

providers.name: Lato
providers.description: Lato (LATO Labs) is a San Francisco company building an agent-native research and simulation platform for investors. Its agents source and conduct hundreds of voice interviews with verified domain experts and customers in any language, each returned with a recording, transcript and thematic analysis, then combine those interviews with thousands of documents from public sources and a fund's own proprietary knowledge into a single commercial study. The study becomes a live simulation of the market that analysts can question and run scenarios against to predict where a market is headed. Investors use Lato for commercial due diligence, expert interviews, market sizing, competitive mapping, customer interviews, pricing studies, deal sourcing, inbound screening and portfolio value creation, compressing research that traditionally costs hundreds of thousands of dollars and takes weeks into hours. The product integrates with the tools investment teams already run on, including Outlook, SharePoint, Gmail, Google Drive, Slack, Teams, Excel, Affinity, Attio, Harmonic and Granola. Lato was founded by Tymek Staniszewski (CEO) and Tien Chu (CTO), is backed by Y Combinator (Summer 2026), and builds on Anthropic, OpenAI and ElevenLabs. As of this profile Lato publishes no public developer API, documentation or SDKs; the company surface is captured here for discovery and the repository will be re-enriched when a developer program appears.

providers.name: Siolla
providers.description: Siolla is a Saudi financial-technology company offering a consumer investment-management mobile application. It provides professionally managed, fully Sharia-compliant investment portfolios, an in-app academy and educational resources covering financial fundamentals, budgeting and investment strategy, and simplified access to investing for modern investors. Siolla is licensed and regulated by the Saudi Capital Market Authority. The company presents a consumer app and website only; no public developer program, API, or developer documentation is published at this time.

providers.name: Smart Bricks Holdings Limited
providers.description: Smart Bricks Holdings Limited operates Smart Bricks, an AI-powered real estate investment platform that uses proprietary foundational models and autonomous agents to help retail and institutional investors discover, underwrite, execute, and monitor property deals globally. Backed by a16z, Google, NVIDIA, Microsoft, Techstars, and 500 Global, the company automates deal sourcing, risk modeling across 1,000+ variables per opportunity, diligence, documentation, and portfolio intelligence. This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; Smart Bricks currently publishes a consumer and institutional web application but no public API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Stifel Financial
providers.description: Stifel Financial is a financial services holding company whose subsidiaries provide securities brokerage, investment banking, trading, investment advisory, and related financial services to individual investors, corporations, and government entities. Stifel bank accounts are accessible via open banking data aggregators including Plaid and Finicity (Mastercard) for third-party financial applications.

providers.name: Tailorbird
providers.description: Tailorbird is a CapEx orchestration platform for the multifamily real estate industry, replacing spreadsheet-based capital planning with AI-generated property intelligence. The platform produces unit-level as-builts, takeoffs, and interior models, runs renovation ROI and five-year capital plans, and tracks spend and budget variance in real time across apartment portfolios. Tailorbird ingests PCAs and property documents, integrates with major property-management ERPs including Yardi, RealPage, Entrata, and MRI via custom APIs and ELTs, and maintains SOC 2 Type II compliance. Founded in 2020 and based in Princeton, New Jersey, it serves 28 of the NMHC Top 50 operators and manages more than $2B in annual CapEx across over one million mapped units. It is a Bloomberg Beta portfolio company.

providers.name: wacai
providers.description: Wacai (挖财, Hangzhou Wacai Network Technology Co., Ltd.) is a Chinese fintech and personal-finance company founded in 2009, best known for its "挖财记账" personal accounting and bookkeeping app and its internet wealth-management platform. Beyond its consumer apps, Wacai operates a partner-facing open API gateway (挖财开放平台) at open.wacai.com that exposes services through a single JSON-over-HTTPS entry point using appKey/appSecret signed requests, with official client SDKs published for Java (Maven Central), Node.js, PHP, Go, and C#. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners.

providers.name: Apis Partners
providers.description: Apis Partners is a London-headquartered private equity asset manager investing in tech-enabled financial infrastructure and financial services businesses across Europe and Growth Markets. With additional offices in Dubai and Singapore, the firm backs companies in payments, digital banking, insurance technology and lending, taking minority positions with governance rights. Apis manages approximately $2.3 billion in assets under management and reports over $1 billion in portfolio realizations, with portfolio companies reaching more than 244 million people. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Anthemis and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; the firm is an investor rather than an API producer, so it exposes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Bibit
providers.description: Bibit is an Indonesian retail investment application that lets everyday users invest in mutual funds (reksa dana), government bonds (SBN/SBR/ORI), fixed-rate bonds, and stocks. Built for beginner investors, it uses robo-advisor technology to recommend diversified portfolios and is licensed by Indonesia's financial regulator OJK. Bibit operates within the Stockbit group and is a portfolio company of Prosus Ventures. As of this profile no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal is published; this repo tracks the company's public surface (security.txt, legal, help, blog) for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Kickstarter
providers.description: Kickstarter is a public-benefit crowdfunding platform where creators launch funding campaigns for creative projects — film, music, art, design, games, technology, publishing, and more — and backers pledge money to help bring them to life on an all-or-nothing funding model. Founded in 2009 and headquartered in Brooklyn, New York, it has channeled billions of dollars in pledges to hundreds of thousands of successfully funded projects. Kickstarter does not currently operate a public developer API program or developer portal; its GraphQL and REST endpoints power its own web and mobile clients and are not documented for third-party integration. The company does maintain an active open-source GitHub organization (including its iOS and Android app source), a help center, and a company blog. This API Evangelist profile tracks Kickstarter's public developer, security, and platform surface for discovery and enrichment.

providers.name: Sarwa
providers.description: Sarwa is a UAE-based fintech platform and mobile app that lets everyday investors trade U.S. stocks and ETFs, invest passively through managed portfolios, and save in high-yield accounts, all in one place. The company is regulated by the Financial Services Regulatory Authority (FSRA) of the Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM) and operates as Sarwa Digital Wealth (Capital) Limited. Sarwa is a portfolio company of 500 Global and offers consumer products (Sarwa Trade, Sarwa Invest, Sarwa Save) through its web and mobile apps; it does not currently publish a public developer API. This profile captures the company's public identity, security posture, and web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: StepStone Group
providers.description: StepStone Group is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The StepStone Group API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Wikifolio
providers.description: wikifolio (wikifolio Financial Technologies AG) is a European social- and copy-trading platform that lets everyday investors follow, compare, and invest in the strategies of experienced traders. Traders build virtual portfolios ("wikifolios") that are published transparently; in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland the best-performing wikifolios can be securitized as exchange-listed wikifolio certificates that investors buy through their bank or broker. The platform surfaces thousands of trading ideas with published rules, fees, and live performance tracking. wikifolio was surfaced as a portfolio company of Speedinvest and is profiled in the API Evangelist network; it does not appear to publish a public developer API at this time.

providers.name: Con.doit
providers.description: Con.doit (condoit.io) is a digital platform for electrical contractors that turns field-captured electrical infrastructure data into recurring service revenue. Its mobile capture app collects on-site photos, thermal scans, and system data, then generates same-day infrared thermography reports, auto-updating single-line diagrams, asset tags, arc flash studies, and NFPA 70B preventive-maintenance programs. Con.doit is a FLIR Global Approved App and reports over 4.5 million electrical assets under management across 2,000+ critical facilities nationwide. No public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI specification is currently published; this profile is enriched from the public marketing surface only.

providers.name: DiversyFund
providers.description: DiversyFund is a San Diego based private-markets investment platform that packages institutional-style fixed income and multifamily real estate offerings for individual accredited investors. Formed in 2016 and qualified under SEC Regulation A+, the firm acts as sponsor, developer and manager of its own funds rather than as a broker, and reports having acquired more than $300 million across 20+ multifamily properties for a base of 28,000+ investors. Its current offering, the Distressed Income Fund, is a Reg D 506(c) preferred-equity vehicle sold to accredited investors with a target allocation of $100K to $1M. Investing is transacted through a private, authenticated investor portal at portal.diversyfund.com (WorkOS AuthKit); DiversyFund publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Enurgen
providers.description: Enurgen is a solar energy software company whose DUET platform uses 3D physics-based modeling to optimize photovoltaic assets across their entire lifecycle. The platform spans three products - Design, Construction, and Operations - helping large-scale solar developers, independent power producers, EPC engineers, and asset managers improve energy yield estimates, validate construction against expected performance, and monitor plants in production to close the gap between forecasted (P50) and actual field output. Enurgen is a Techstars-backed company; customers include Scatec, Potentia, Lightsource, Eni, and Kiewit. The company operates a customer web application at app.enurgen.com but does not currently publish a public developer API, documentation, or SDKs. This API Evangelist profile is an enrichment pass that captures the company's public web properties and domain security posture.

providers.name: EquityBee
providers.description: EquityBee is a fintech marketplace that helps startup employees fund the exercise of their stock options before those options expire, giving them the cash needed to purchase their equity while the company is still private. On the other side of the marketplace, EquityBee connects accredited investors with the opportunity to invest in pre-IPO companies by funding those employee option exercises in exchange for a share of the future proceeds. Founded in 2018, the company operates a two-sided platform spanning startup employees, accredited investors, and the private companies whose equity underlies each funded position. EquityBee publishes a public marketing and account website but exposes no public developer API, SDK, or machine-readable API discovery surface at this time.

providers.name: Halogen Capital
providers.description: Halogen Capital is Malaysia's first and only licensed digital asset fund manager, regulated by the Securities Commission Malaysia (License eCMSL/A0388/2023) and headquartered in Kuala Lumpur. The firm gives high-net-worth individuals, family offices, corporates, and institutional investors regulated access to cryptocurrency and traditional assets through unit trust structures, offering Shariah-compliant Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Crypto Titans basket funds alongside a MYR liquid fund, a ringgit income fund, and an enhanced income fund, all secured with multi-signature custody. Backed by Kenanga Investment Bank and 500 Global, Halogen manages roughly RM400 million in assets under management and is expanding into real-world asset (RWA) tokenization. This API Evangelist profile currently tracks the company's public web presence and domain-security posture; no public developer API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Hum Capital
providers.description: Hum Capital operates an AI-powered funding marketplace that connects growth companies with the right institutional capital. Through its Intelligent Capital Market platform, companies share their financial and operating data once and are matched to a network of 900+ lenders and investors for non-dilutive and structured financing (typically $1M-$50M), while investors receive curated, data-driven deal flow. Hum reports more than $700M in capital deployed across 6,000+ companies. Headquartered in New York, the company operates in the financial services, capital markets, and alternative-financing sector. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Partech and enriched from the company's public web surface; Hum publishes no public developer API, so this entry is identity- and security-focused.

providers.name: Jiraaf
providers.description: Jiraaf (Jiraaf Platform Private Limited, Bangalore, India) is an online fixed-income investment platform that lets retail investors discover, analyze, and invest in listed and secured bonds. Its curated product shelf spans listed corporate bonds, sovereign gold bonds, treasury bills, G-Secs and State Development Loans (SDLs), securitized debt instruments (SDIs), and fixed deposits, each surfaced with transparent yields, credit ratings, and a documented credit-evaluation process. Alongside the investing surface it publishes research reports, a bond analyser, a bond directory, a glossary, calculators, and educational content (Bond Gurukul webinars, blogs, and newsletters). Backed by Accel. Jiraaf is a consumer-facing web and mobile investing product and does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures its identity and public web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: London House Exchange (Property Partner)
providers.description: London House Exchange, formerly Property Partner, is an FCA-regulated online platform that operates the world's only regulated exchange for individual residential, student and commercial properties. Founded in 2014 and now owned by US digital homeownership company Better, the platform lets retail investors buy fractional shares in professionally managed UK properties, earn monthly dividends from rental income, and trade those shares with other investors on a secondary market. It also offers property-backed mortgage bonds, an ISA, and bridging finance, with over £100m of fractionalised property assets under management and thousands of investors across more than 80 countries. It was surfaced as a Seedcamp portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Solovis
providers.description: Solovis is a multi-asset investment analytics and portfolio management software platform for institutional investors, including endowments, foundations, pension plans, outsourced CIOs (OCIOs), and family offices. It aggregates data across public and private asset classes into a single dashboard for portfolio modeling, performance analysis, risk analytics, and reporting. Core products include Portfolio Analytics, Risk Analytics, Predict (performance and risk prediction for asset allocation), Risk Pro (factor-based risk analytics, formerly Venn Pro), and Analyst Services for outsourced data capture and portfolio data aggregation. Solovis became part of Nasdaq's investment intelligence business following its 2020 acquisition. The platform is delivered as a private, authenticated SaaS accessed through a client login; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, documentation portal, OpenAPI specification, or `/.well-known/` discovery surface. The host api.solovis.com exists but is fully authentication-gated (HTTP 401) with no public specification.

providers.name: Watsi
providers.description: Watsi is a San Francisco-based 501(c)(3) nonprofit crowdfunding platform that lets donors directly fund surgeries and medical care for patients in low-income countries, working through vetted medical partners across Africa, Asia, and Latin America. Founded in 2011 and the first nonprofit funded by Y Combinator, Watsi has directed more than $20 million to patient healthcare. Watsi previously published a read-only JSON API at developers.watsi.org, but that developer portal and api.watsi.org no longer resolve, so no public API surface is currently available.

providers.name: Aboon
providers.description: Aboon is a digital 401(k) retirement-plan platform and third-party administrator (TPA) that helps financial advisors and employers design, launch, and manage workplace retirement plans. It pairs AI-powered workflows with dedicated human plan consultants to generate customized 401(k) proposals in minutes, streamline recordkeeper onboarding, handle digital plan contracting and census intake, and run ongoing compliance testing and Form 3(16) administration. Aboon markets partnerships with major recordkeepers (American Funds, Empower, John Hancock, and others) and serves a network of advisors nationwide. It is a fintech company backed by Bain Capital Ventures. No public developer/API surface has been identified.

providers.name: Aura Finance
providers.description: Aura Finance is an employer-sponsored financial wellness platform that blends behavioral psychology with money management to help employees reach financial stability and peace of mind. The San Francisco fintech — a Techstars Economic Mobility 2023 company and an SEC-registered investment adviser (CRD 318940) — delivers goal-based automated investing, one-on-one financial coaching over chat, budgeting and saving tools, financial-literacy workshops, mindfulness exercises to reduce money stress, and a money-personality quiz, offered through a B2B2C model to organizations and their workforces. The company publishes no public developer program, API, or SDKs; its member application lives at web.aurafi.io.

providers.name: Eton Solutions
providers.description: Eton Solutions, L.P. is a Morrisville, North Carolina wealth-technology company that builds AtlasFive, a purpose-built ERP platform for single-family offices, multi-family offices, private funds and the ultra-high-net-worth families they serve. AtlasFive consolidates general ledger and partnership/fund/trust accounting, investment management and performance, bill pay and transaction processing, tax workflow, CRM and document management onto one data core, and aggregates positions and transactions from more than 1,500 banks and custodians via direct electronic feeds, portal scrapes, PDF statement extraction and partner aggregators. The EtonAI product line layers a knowledge graph and generative-AI assistants over that core. Integration is delivered through customer-scoped Reporting APIs and a Power BI connector rather than a public developer program: Eton Solutions publishes no public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI definition, SDK or sandbox as of August 2026. The company does publish a substantial compliance posture — ISO/IEC 42001 (AI management), ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 27701, SOC 1 Type II and SOC 2 Type II, with GDPR and CCPA alignment — and the platform is hosted on Microsoft Azure. Founded out of the multi-family office Eton Advisors and led by CEO Robert Mallernee with Executive Chairman Satyen Patel, with additional offices in Dubai and Bengaluru.

providers.name: Flock Homes
providers.description: Flock Homes is a real estate investment platform, founded in 2020 and backed by a16z, that lets individual rental-property owners retire from active landlording by contributing their single-family and multifamily homes into a professionally managed, diversified residential real estate fund. Flock uses a 721 Exchange (an UPREIT contribution) so owners can trade appreciated rental property for fund shares on a tax-deferred basis, deferring capital gains and depreciation-recapture taxes while eliminating repair, vacancy, and eviction responsibilities. Fund investors receive quarterly cash-flow distributions and long-term appreciation across a nationwide portfolio, with Flock handling all property management, maintenance, and tenant operations. No public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface has been found; this profile is maintained as a company record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Motilal Oswal
providers.description: Motilal Oswal Financial Services Limited (MOFSL) is a diversified Indian financial services company offering equity and derivatives broking, wealth management, asset management, mutual funds, IPO access, investment banking, private equity, and home finance. Surfaced as a portfolio company of bessemer-venture-partners and profiled in the API Evangelist network. The public surface is a consumer/corporate investing website built on Adobe Experience Manager Edge Delivery Services; no public developer API or OpenAPI is published (algorithmic/partner trading access sits behind a partner login).

providers.name: SkySpecs
providers.description: SkySpecs is a renewable energy asset management company based in Ann Arbor, Michigan that combines autonomous drone inspections, condition-monitoring hardware, and its cloud-based Horizon software platform to help wind and solar operators manage the health and performance of their assets. Horizon consolidates blade inspection imagery, drivetrain and sensor data, SCADA-based performance analytics, repair-vendor coordination, and financial reporting into one hub, with third-party data ingestion and custom integrations for fleet owners. The company reports assets under contract across six countries and is backed by Goldman Sachs Asset Management. SkySpecs exposes no public developer API, SDK, or self-serve developer portal today; integrations are arranged directly with the Horizon team.

providers.name: Startup Buffer
providers.description: Startup Buffer is a community-driven directory and platform for discovering new startups, products, and innovations across various industries. The platform offers startup submission, browsing, and discovery features through web and mobile applications.

providers.name: Startup Ranking
providers.description: Startup Ranking is a platform that tracks, ranks, and indexes startups worldwide based on web presence, social metrics, and growth signals. It provides startup discovery, competitive benchmarking, and market intelligence for investors, entrepreneurs, and researchers.

providers.name: Backstartup
providers.description: Backstartup is a Colombian tech-enabled accounting and legal services firm for startups and small businesses (notably SAS entities). It automated company formation, bookkeeping, tax filing, payroll, and legal/DIAN compliance for founders in Latin America. Backstartup has since been integrated into Numbi (numbi.ai), a tech-enabled accounting firm that operates monthly bookkeeping, taxes, payroll, and DIAN compliance on top of the accounting systems companies already use (Siigo and Alegra), pairing expert accountants with automation and AI. Backstartup's legacy domain (backstartup.com) now redirects to numbi.ai and Backstartup operates as a sub-organization within Numbi's Colombia operation. This is a services-company profile: no public developer API or OpenAPI is published. It entered the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio lead.

providers.name: Douglas Elliman
providers.description: Douglas Elliman Inc. (NYSE: DOUG) is a residential real estate brokerage founded in 1911 and headquartered at 575 Madison Avenue, New York City. It is one of the largest brokerages in the New York metropolitan area and among the largest in the United States, with roughly 6,000 agents across New York, Florida, California, Texas, Colorado, Massachusetts, Connecticut, Nevada, New Jersey, Vermont, the Mid-Atlantic, and international outposts in France and Monaco. Its home market is the United States. In the value chain Douglas Elliman sits on the SELL side as a licensed brokerage and MLS participant — it consumes MLS listing data under IDX and broker agreements rather than originating a syndicated feed — and it extends into development marketing, property management, commercial brokerage, title and escrow (Douglas Elliman Title), relocation, and PropTech venture investment through New Valley Ventures. Its API posture is honest and thin: no developer portal, no published API documentation, no OpenAPI or OData $metadata contract, and no published access path of any kind. developer.elliman.com, developers.elliman.com, and docs.elliman.com all resolve to the marketing homepage via a wildcard catch-all rather than to a portal, and api.elliman.com exists as an IIS/ASP.NET host that returns HTTP 403 at its root with no documentation behind it. On RESO, Douglas Elliman Real Estate is listed as a Class D member (Brokers, Agents and Appraisers) on the RESO membership roster but does NOT appear in the RESO certified-organizations directory — it is a RESO member, not a RESO-certified data provider, and it publishes no Web API or Data Dictionary certification, no OData endpoint, and no UPI surface. The single public engineering artifact the company ships is a GitHub fork of a third-party .NET RETS client library, which is consumer-side evidence that Elliman pulls MLS data in rather than producer-side evidence that it exposes any.

providers.name: iCapital Network
providers.description: iCapital (Institutional Capital Network, Inc.) is a New York-headquartered financial technology company, founded in 2013, that operates the alternative investments marketplace and the operating infrastructure behind it. Its platform lets wealth managers, RIAs, family offices and institutional investors research, subscribe to, service and report on private markets funds, hedge funds, structured investments, annuities, model portfolios and separately managed accounts, while asset managers use it to distribute those products into the wealth channel. iCapital Marketplace advertises access to funds from 700+ asset managers and reports $945B+ in global platform assets. Around the marketplace sit Architect (portfolio construction and analytics), Data Solutions (alternative data management and consolidated reporting), Identity Solutions (KYC/AML), and iCapital DLT, an API-first distributed ledger platform built on the Canton Network. Integration with custodians, fund administrators, transfer agents and advisor platforms (BNY, Fidelity, Envestnet, Orion, Morningstar, Vestmark, TradePMR, GeoWealth, Ultimus, UMB) happens through SSO, embedded workflows and partner data integrations. As of the 2026-08-01 enrichment pass iCapital publishes no public developer portal, API reference, machine-readable API contract or client SDKs; API documentation is described as available to integration partners only, through the sales and technical-support organization.

providers.name: Ray White
providers.description: Ray White is Australasia's largest real estate group, a family-owned brokerage network founded in 1902 and headquartered in Brisbane, Australia, running 550+ Australian offices and roughly a thousand offices in total across Australia, New Zealand, Indonesia, Hong Kong, China, Papua New Guinea, the Middle East and Atlanta USA, spanning residential sales, auctions, commercial (Ray White Commercial / rwc.com.au), rural and livestock, property management, projects, marine, hotels, valuations, business sales, insurance and mortgage broking through sister brand Loan Market. In the Australian property value chain Ray White sits on the AGENCY side of a portal duopoly — it lists into REA Group's realestate.com.au and Domain rather than operating a portal or a registry of its own — and it is an API CONSUMER, not an API producer. In December 2025 Ray White named realestate.com.au and PropTrack its data partners explicitly for their "industry leading API architecture", piping that licensed market data into its proprietary OneSystem, NurtureCloud and Pulse platforms. Its API posture is therefore honestly stated as none-published — as of 2026-07-26 no developer portal, no public API documentation, no OpenAPI or OData $metadata contract, and no published partner-API application path could be found on raywhite.com or any developer/api/docs subdomain (all of which fail DNS resolution). RESO is absent — Ray White does not appear in the RESO certification directory, which is unsurprising because RESO is a North American, NAR-driven mandate with no Australian counterpart; Australia's closest thing to a required machine-readable property rail is PEXA electronic conveyancing, which Ray White transacts through as a participant rather than exposes.

providers.name: RCS Capital
providers.description: RCS Capital Corporation (RCAP) was a publicly traded holding company focused on the financial services industry, founded by Nicholas Schorsch and taken public in June 2013. The firm owned a diversified group of businesses including independent broker-dealers, investment banking, capital markets, and transaction management services. It assembled Cetera Financial Group to become the second largest network of independent broker-dealers in the United States, with approximately 9,100 financial advisors managing $220 billion in assets under administration for 2.5 million clients. RCS Capital filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection in January 2016, citing $1.39 billion in debts, and emerged in May 2016 as Aretec Group, Inc., the holding company of Cetera Financial Group. No public developer APIs were offered under the RCS Capital brand.

providers.name: Vouch
providers.description: Vouch is a San Francisco, California business insurance broker and risk advisor purpose-built for high-growth startups and the venture ecosystem. Founded in 2018 by Sam Hodges and Travis Hedge and backed by investors including Ribbit Capital, SVB Capital, Redpoint Ventures, Y Combinator, and MS&AD Ventures, Vouch offers a tailored portfolio of commercial coverages — Directors & Officers (D&O), Errors & Omissions (E&O / Tech E&O / Professional Services E&O), Cyber, Employment Practices Liability (EPL), General Liability, Business Property, Fiduciary, Crime, and contract-required coverages — sold to technology, healthcare and life sciences, financial services, and professional services companies. The business model is broker-of-record commissions and, since 2021, a Vouch-owned insurance carrier underwriting select lines. Vouch is best known in the developer community for its embedded insurance program, which lets ecosystem partners (Carta, StartupOS, and similar founder platforms) pre-fill applications, surface quotes, and bind coverage inline via Vouch's partner API. Public developer documentation, an OpenAPI specification, and a self-serve sandbox are not exposed; the partner API and Vouch Corporate documentation (hosted on GitBook) are gated to onboarded venture, technology, and service-provider partners contracted through hello@vouch.us.

providers.name: Omnidian
providers.description: Omnidian, Inc. is a Seattle-based clean energy performance assurance company, founded in 2015, that protects and accelerates investments in residential and commercial solar and battery storage. Its proprietary, machine-learning driven software platform continuously monitors distributed solar assets, diagnoses hardware, communication and environmental faults such as soiling, shading and snow, dispatches a nationwide field service technician network across 48 states, Washington D.C. and Puerto Rico, and underwrites a 95% energy production guarantee that reimburses owners for covered shortfalls. Omnidian serves installers, EPCs, developers, IPPs, solar financing providers, commercial real estate owners and asset investors, and is a Certified B Corporation and a member of the SunSpec Alliance. Its monitoring platform, client portal and field service partner portal are operated as private, authenticated systems; Omnidian publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Securian Financial
providers.description: Securian Financial Group is a Saint Paul, Minnesota-based mutual holding company offering life insurance, annuities, institutional retirement solutions, trust services, investment management and group workplace benefits to individuals, employers, financial institutions and institutional clients across the United States and Canada. Its operating companies include Minnesota Life Insurance Company, Securian Life Insurance Company, Securian Asset Management and Securian Canada. Securian does not run a public developer program: its integration surfaces are partner-facing and sales-gated. Securian Platform Connect exchanges benefits data with employer benefits-administration platforms using LIMRA LDEx standards (Evidence of Insurability and Benefits Enrollment Management) plus SSO, API notifications and file feeds, and FlexTech - launched March 2026 with Walnut - embeds payment protection into digital lending journeys through API-based integration. Neither publishes a machine-readable contract, developer portal or self-service onboarding.

providers.name: AfterHour
providers.description: AfterHour is a social copy-trading and investing community for retail investors, founded in 2022 and headquartered in San Francisco. The mobile app lets verified traders connect their real brokerage accounts and share live, proven positions — more than $300M in live trades every day — so members can follow top traders, copy trades, discuss tickers in real-time stock chat rooms, receive alerts, and track their own portfolios. AfterHour is backed by Founders Fund and General Catalyst. This provider was surfaced as a General Catalyst portfolio company; it publishes a consumer app and marketing site but no public developer API at this time.

providers.name: Avenue One
providers.description: Avenue One is a New York-based technology service platform and investment marketplace for institutional owners, buyers, sellers, lenders and borrowers of residential rental real estate. Founded in 2020, it connects institutional debt and equity capital to local operating partners and property owners across 21+ U.S. markets, combining proprietary property data, automated valuation, and a vetted partner network to find, finance, buy, renovate, lease, manage and sell single-family rental homes at scale. Its service lines span lending (bridge and SFR portfolio loans), strategy development, acquisitions, renovations, asset management, title and brokerage or dispositions. The company reports $2.2B+ of capital deployed. Its software runs as a private, login-gated product suite ("AvenueOS") for internal, builder, investor and partner users; no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable contract is published.

providers.name: EDITED
providers.description: EDITED is an AI-powered retail intelligence platform that helps retailers, buyers, merchandisers, planners, designers, and eCommerce teams make data-driven decisions across assortment, pricing, and promotions. Its Market API (the EDITED Data product) exposes a large normalized retail market data set — SKUs, brands, categories, pricing, and assortment signals across thousands of retailers and many countries — so organizations can benchmark against competitors in real time, spot emerging trends early, and integrate competitive intelligence into their own systems. The company is a Seedcamp portfolio company; access to the Market API is sales-gated (demo / contact sales) with no public developer portal or OpenAPI at this time.

providers.name: fomo
providers.description: fomo (FOMO Labs Inc.) is a social-first cryptocurrency trading platform available as a mobile app and web platform. It lets mainstream retail investors trade memecoins, altcoins, and stablecoins across multiple blockchains without managing wallets, paying gas fees, or transferring assets manually, wrapping on-chain trading in a social layer where users discover tokens, follow top traders, view real-time buy alerts, copy trades, and compete on leaderboards. Onboarding is quick with Apple Pay funding, and trading is multichain and gasless. Founded in 2025 by former Deutsche Bank and dYdX team members (CEO Paul Erlanger, Se Yong Park, Prashan Dharmasena), the New York company reports 500,000+ active traders, 625,000+ total users, and $4B+ in trading volume. In June 2026 it raised a $75M Series B led by Index Ventures with Union Square Ventures and Benchmark at a $550M valuation. fomo is a consumer-facing product and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this API Evangelist profile captures its company identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Funding Societies | Modalku
providers.description: Funding Societies (known as Modalku in Indonesia) is Southeast Asia's largest SME digital financing and investment platform, connecting small and medium enterprises seeking working capital with individual and institutional investors. Operating across Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam and Hong Kong, the platform offers micro loans, business term loans, invoice and accounts-payable/receivable financing, startup financing and property-backed secured lending, alongside investment products for lenders. It is licensed and regulated (Capital Markets Services License, Monetary Authority of Singapore) and was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API, documentation, or developer portal is currently published.

providers.name: Hamilton Lane
providers.description: Hamilton Lane is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Hamilton Lane API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Calastone
providers.description: Calastone operates the world's largest global funds network, connecting asset managers, distributors, custodians and platforms to automate and digitalize the investment funds marketplace. Founded in 2007 and headquartered in London, it provides order routing, settlements, share-class conversions, dividends, transfers, reporting, money market services and tokenized fund distribution. More than 4,500 clients across 58 countries and territories use the network, processing over £300 billion of investment value each month. API and messaging connectivity is delivered through client onboarding rather than a public self-service developer portal. Calastone is a wholly owned subsidiary of SS&C Technologies Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: SSNC).

providers.name: LVX (formerly LetsVenture)
providers.description: LVX — formerly LetsVenture — is an India-based private market investing platform founded in 2013 by Shanti Mohan and headquartered in Bengaluru, with teams in Delhi and Mumbai. The platform connects startup founders raising capital with angel investors, family offices and VCs, and has been a SEBI-regulated entity since its Angel AIF was approved in 2018. Its product surface spans LVX start (early-stage angel investing), LVX grow (growth-stage and co-investment deals), LVXschool (private market investor education), LVX Debt (non-dilutive debt financing for startups) and LVX Track (portfolio dashboards), alongside the sister platform trica. The company publicly reports 35K+ startups, 14K+ investors and over Rs 1500 Cr of AIF assets under management. LVX rebranded from LetsVenture in July 2025 and letsventure.com now redirects to lvxventures.com. LVX operates no public developer API program: no developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI definition or SDKs were found, and the platform-backing API at api.lvxventures.com is a private token-authenticated service.

providers.name: Timeless
providers.description: Timeless (Timeless Investments GmbH) is a Berlin-based fintech that lets people invest in fractions of authenticated collectibles - luxury watches, classic cars, sneakers, fine wine, art, and memorabilia - starting at 50 EUR through its iOS and Android app. Assets are curated, authenticated, and securitized so users can buy, hold, and trade shares and exit when an asset sells. Backed by EQT Ventures. Timeless is a consumer mobile-app platform and publishes no public developer portal or API; its api.timeless.investments backend is private and authenticated.

providers.name: Bunch
providers.description: Bunch is a Berlin-based financial technology company building AI-native infrastructure for private markets. Its all-in-one platform combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows, and expert fund services so venture capital and private equity funds and investors can seamlessly transact, close, and securely operate — spanning fund administration, SPV and vehicle setup, investor onboarding and KYC, capital calls, and reporting. Bunch was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and Northzone and profiled into the API Evangelist network. Bunch operates a private, customer-facing product at app.bunch.capital and does not publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: Exporo
providers.description: Exporo is a Hamburg, Germany-based digital investment platform for real estate and renewable-energy infrastructure, operating as a regulated European Crowdfunding Service Provider (ECSP). The platform lets private investors participate in residential and commercial property development as well as clean-energy projects such as solar, with typical terms of 12-36 months. Exporo has mediated over EUR 1.17 billion of capital across more than 600 financed projects, and also offers Club Deals for larger qualified investors. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Partech and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API or developer portal is currently published; this profile is maintained as a company lead and will be enriched if a developer surface appears.

providers.name: Trade Republic
providers.description: Trade Republic is a Berlin-based digital bank and Europe's largest savings platform, offering commission-optimized trading of stocks, ETFs, derivatives, and crypto, ETF and stock savings plans, interest on uninvested cash, and a Visa card. Trade Republic Bank GmbH holds a full German banking license and serves customers across European markets. The company publishes no public developer API, API documentation, or first-party SDKs — its mobile and web apps run on a private WebSocket-based backend (api.traderepublic.com) that a community ecosystem of unofficial clients has grown around.

providers.name: Ares Management
providers.description: Ares Management is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Ares Management API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Atomic
providers.description: Atomic (Atomic Invest) is an investing-as-a-service platform that lets fintechs, banks, and financial institutions embed professionally managed investing, cash management, and brokerage products into their own apps through developer-first APIs. Its turnkey and API-driven offerings span wealth management (custom and direct indexing, bond laddering, tax-loss harvesting, and ESG investing), cash management (high-yield and money market accounts), and modern brokerage (fractional stocks, bonds, ETFs, and alternative assets across global markets), while Atomic carries the underlying brokerage operations, regulatory, and compliance burden so partners can launch in weeks. Backed by Anthemis and QED Investors.

providers.name: Avantos
providers.description: Avantos is an AI-native operating system for client management in financial services, built for wealth management and advisory firms. The platform unifies client data, products, teams, and workflows into a knowledge graph that powers agentic onboarding, relationship intelligence, and an AI-powered servicing workspace where agents anticipate client needs and streamline operations. It integrates with existing CRMs, custodians, and core systems, and is SOC 2 compliant with enterprise-grade architecture. Avantos raised a $35M Series A led by Bessemer Venture Partners, announced February 2026.

providers.name: BNP Paribas
providers.description: BNP Paribas is a leading international banking group providing a wide range of financial services to individuals, businesses, and institutions worldwide. The company offers APIs through its CIB Developer Portal covering capital markets, payment services, securities services, and open banking integrations for corporate and institutional clients.

providers.name: Entrepreneur First
providers.description: Entrepreneur First (EF) is a talent investor that backs exceptional individuals before they have a company, pairing them into cofounding teams and providing pre-seed capital, mentorship, and a global network to build technology startups from scratch. Founded in London in 2011 by Matt Clifford and Alice Bentinck, EF runs cohort-based programs across Europe, Asia, and North America and has helped launch hundreds of venture-backed companies. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Greylock and added to the API Evangelist network; EF publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Halo Investing
providers.description: Halo Investing is a Chicago-based financial technology company that operates a marketplace for "protective investments" — structured notes, multi-manager structured note SMAs, buffered ETFs, annuities and insurance — connecting financial advisors, RIAs and financial institutions with more than 40 global banking and insurance issuers. Founded in 2015 by Biju Kulathakal and Jason Barsema, the platform lets advisors analyze, customize, price, execute and then monitor outcome-based products from a single dashboard, with tools such as the Aura portfolio simulator and an asset allocation framework for structured notes. Halo reports more than $45.5B in transactions since 2015 and employs 100+ people. Its affiliate Halo Securities LLC is an SEC-registered broker-dealer and a member of FINRA/SIPC, acting as distributor and selling agent for structured note products. The advisor platform at notes.haloinvesting.com is entirely authenticated behind a login. As of this profiling pass Halo Investing publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/GraphQL contract, SDK, CLI, MCP server or A2A agent card; advisor-side API integration is offered through the third-party Schwab OpenView Gateway rather than a Halo-published API.

providers.name: La Haus
providers.description: La Haus is a Latin American proptech company, founded in 2017 and headquartered in Medellín and Bogotá, Colombia, that operates the residential real-estate marketplaces lahaus.com (Colombia) and lahaus.mx (Mexico) together with an in-house brokerage. The platform lists de-duplicated, verified new-construction and resale housing from vetted developers, adds mortgage and down-payment simulators, buyer guides and an AI assistant, and takes buyers through negotiation and closing at no cost to the buyer. It has raised more than $135M in equity plus debt facilities from Kaszek, NFX, Acrew Capital, Greenspring Associates, SoftBank and Bezos Expeditions. La Haus publishes NO public developer portal, API documentation, SDK or machine-readable contract: the consumer sites are server-rendered applications whose /api/* paths are disallowed in robots.txt, and api.lahaus.com is a private AWS API Gateway that answers every anonymous request with MissingAuthenticationToken. Partner/portal syndication runs through access-controlled marketing feed integrations (Trovit). This profile therefore records the company's public web surface and security posture rather than an API surface.

providers.name: Alvarez & Marsal
providers.description: Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a leading global professional services firm, founded in 1983 by Tony Alvarez II and Bryan Marsal and headquartered in New York City. Privately held, the firm employs more than 10,000 people across six continents and is best known for turnaround and restructuring engagements (Lehman Brothers, HealthSouth, Tribune, FTX, Arthur Andersen) and for performance improvement, tax advisory, transaction advisory, disputes and investigations, valuation, and private equity performance improvement (PEPI) services. A&M does not operate a public developer portal; technology is delivered through client engagements, internal proprietary tools, A&M Capital Partners (the firm's investment arm), and a public Insights / thought-leadership surface published on alvarezandmarsal.com.

providers.name: Based
providers.description: Based is a consumer crypto super app built on Hyperliquid that unifies trading, prediction markets, and real-world payments in a single self-custody account. Users trade spot and perpetual futures with sub-second execution and deep liquidity, speculate on prediction markets, and spend crypto from Solana, Arbitrum, and Polygon at 70+ million Visa merchants across 160+ countries via Based debit cards, including the premium Gold+ card. BasedCloud lets partners spin up white-label Hyperliquid trading frontends (web, mobile, desktop, Telegram), and a three-tiered affiliate program amplifies Hyperliquid referral fees. Based is backed by Pantera Capital, Coinbase Ventures, Hashed, Ethena, and Spartan Group. It publishes consumer product docs on GitBook and an agent-oriented llms.txt index, but exposes no public developer API of its own — programmatic trading runs on the underlying Hyperliquid API.

providers.name: First Horizon
providers.description: First Horizon Corporation is a Fortune 500 financial services holding company headquartered in Memphis, Tennessee. Through First Horizon Bank it provides commercial, private, consumer, and mortgage banking, wealth management, and capital markets services across the southern United States. First Horizon operates a real API Banking developer portal for Treasury Management clients, exposing RESTful products for money movement, ACH origination, real-time account information, and routing-number lookups, secured with OAuth 2.0 and a sandbox for build-and-test integration. Onboarding is partner/relationship gated and no OpenAPI/Swagger specifications are publicly downloadable — this repository captures the documented API surface honestly, humanURL-only.

providers.name: Confluence Unity
providers.description: Confluence Unity is the unified fund administration and reporting platform from Confluence Technologies, a software provider focused on the global investment management industry. The Unity suite (including Unity Financial Reporting, Unity Performance, and Unity Rex for AI-driven reconciliation) consolidates data, regulatory and shareholder reporting, and performance analytics for asset managers, fund administrators, and asset servicers. Confluence operates Unity as a hosted SaaS platform with integrations into client data warehouses; the public site does not publish open developer API documentation, so developer access is typically arranged through Confluence account teams.

providers.name: Fabric Technologies
providers.description: Fabric Technologies operates Fabric by Gerber Life, a direct-to-consumer financial services platform built for parents and families. The company offers term life insurance with an instant online quote and application flow, UGMA custodial investment accounts and 529 college-savings plans for children, and digital estate-planning tools including free wills. Fabric is backed by Gerber Life, part of Western & Southern Financial Group, and was originally venture-funded by Bessemer Venture Partners. The platform emphasizes fast, accessible, mobile-first family financial planning spanning protection, wealth-building, and legacy planning. Fabric is a consumer-facing service and does not currently publish a public developer API or portal.

providers.name: Frec
providers.description: Frec is a San Francisco fintech offering tax-aware, automated direct indexing for retail investors. Its products — Classic Direct Indexing, Long Short Direct Indexing, Diversify, Trade, Treasury cash management, and a Portfolio Line of Credit — replicate market indices with individual stocks while running automated tax-loss harvesting to minimize capital gains taxes at fees starting around 0.09%. Frec is an SEC-registered investment adviser and SIPC member managing over $1.25B in assets, founded by Mo Al Adham and backed by Greylock. The company ships a consumer investing app and website but does not currently expose a public developer API, so this profile is identity- and security-posture-only.

providers.name: FundersClub
providers.description: FundersClub is an online venture capital firm and investment platform based in San Francisco that lets accredited investors browse, evaluate, and invest in curated early-stage technology startups through professionally managed, single-purpose venture funds. Founders apply for funding and, once selected, gain access to capital, a partner network, and post-investment support. Backed by a16z, Felicis, and Y Combinator, FundersClub pioneered the online VC model. The company publishes no public developer API; this API Evangelist profile tracks its web, identity, and domain-security surface for the network.

providers.name: Novus
providers.description: Novus (operating as SEI Novus) is a portfolio intelligence and investment analytics platform for institutional investors — endowments, foundations, sovereign wealth funds, family offices, pension funds, and asset managers. The platform provides manager monitoring, performance analysis, risk assessment, attribution, and reporting across public and private markets at the position, fund, and portfolio level, along with data integration and maintenance services. Originally venture-backed (Index Ventures among its investors), Novus was acquired by SEI and now operates as SEI Novus. It has been recognized as Best Portfolio Management Vendor (Family Wealth Report Awards) and Best Multi-Asset Class Portfolio Management System (PAM Awards). No public developer API is currently published on its website.

providers.name: Plus Simple
providers.description: +Simple (Plus Simple) is a French digital insurance underwriting agency (agence de souscription) founded in 2015 and headquartered in Marseille. Operating as one of France's largest wholesale insurance brokers, it runs a fully digital extranet platform that lets partner insurance brokers prospect, price, underwrite, issue, and manage professional insurance contracts across more than 1,200 covered activities and 30+ niche product lines, including RC Décennale (ten-year construction liability) coverage. +Simple distributes on a 100% brokerage model in partnership with carriers such as Hiscox, Allianz, Wakam, QBE and Beazley, serving a network of 8,000+ partner brokers. The company is backed by Anthemis and Speedinvest and was added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio lead; it publishes no public API or developer surface at this time (its broker and insured portals are authenticated web applications, not open APIs).

providers.name: Propseller
providers.description: Propseller is a Singapore-based, technology-powered real estate brokerage founded in 2018 by Adrien Jorge. It helps property owners sell, buy, and rent residential real estate — HDB flats, condominiums, and landed homes — pairing top-performing human property agents with data and technology to deliver an end-to-end transaction experience at a transparent commission starting from 1%. Backed by Vertex Ventures and Partech, Propseller operates a consumer-facing real estate service and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or programmatic integration surface.

providers.name: SEI Investments
providers.description: SEI Investments Company (NASDAQ: SEIC) is a publicly traded financial services and technology provider founded in 1968 and headquartered in Oaks, Pennsylvania. SEI delivers end-to-end technology, operations, and asset management solutions to asset managers, banks and wealth managers, financial advisors, and institutional investors. Marquee platforms include the SEI Wealth Platform (front-to-back wealth management technology and outsourced operations), SEI Data Cloud (managed near-real-time data platform), SEI Sphere (managed IT, cybersecurity, cloud, and network operations), and SEI Novus (institutional portfolio analytics). SEI does not run a public developer portal — partner and client integrations are delivered through contractual onboarding to the SEI Wealth Platform, SEI Connect advisor channels, and managed-service engagements rather than self-serve OpenAPI or SDK distribution.

providers.name: TRDATA
providers.description: TRDATA (TRDATA Technology Limited) is a real-time financial information and communication platform for professional traders, aggregating over-the-counter (OTC) quotes, prices, news, and analytics from market makers across fragmented fixed-income and emerging-market instruments. It covers Ukrainian, CEEMEA, and global bonds, currencies, commodities, and derivatives from local and international data providers, and bundles analytics tools such as a Bond Calculator, Bond Calendar, Swap Curves, real-time asset charts, and a TRDATA Excel add-in. More than 800 institutions -- including Societe Generale, UniCredit, Raiffeisen, BNP Paribas, Barclays, Deutsche Bank, and Commerzbank -- use the platform to read and exchange market information. TRDATA is backed by 500 Global. As of this profile the company publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or documentation surface; access is via registration and the hosted platform.

providers.name: Vise
providers.description: Vise is an SEC-registered investment adviser that provides an AI-powered wealth management platform for financial advisors, RIAs, enterprise wealth firms, and asset managers. The platform helps advisors build personalized, tax-aware portfolios and supports direct indexing, fixed income management, long/short strategies, tax-loss harvesting, portfolio rebalancing, and client reporting, managing over $100B in platform assets across 135K+ accounts. Vise publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK; this profile captures its public company, legal, and domain-security surface for the API Evangelist network.

bands.label: Minimal
bands.blurb: Index entry only; little beyond a description and a link.

providers.name: AIS Group
providers.description: AIS Group — trading as AIS Capital Management, L.P., where AIS stands for "Applied Intelligence Strategies" — is an investment management firm running absolute-return, global macro programs for financial advisors and individual investors. It combines discretionary macroeconomic and intermarket research (the Multi-Asset Allocation Portfolio family) with systematic, shorter-horizon models (the Frontera programs), trading only liquid instruments listed on major exchanges and describing its methodology as transparent rather than black-box. The firm is an investment manager rather than a software vendor: it publishes no public API, no developer program and no machine-readable contract, and its client portal is a licensed third-party workspace rather than software it operates.

providers.name: Pluang
providers.description: Pluang is an Indonesian multi-asset investment and trading platform that lets retail users invest across a single app in US stocks and ETFs (fractional from $1), Indonesian stocks, cryptocurrencies with staking, mutual funds (Reksa Dana), physical gold and silver, options, and leveraged crypto futures. Features include Auto Invest dollar-cost averaging, the Pocket portfolio bundling tool, TradingView-powered charting, USD yield products, and the Aura AI recommendation assistant. Pluang operates under OJK and Bappebti regulatory oversight across its subsidiaries and reports 12M+ users.
