It exposes no public developer API; this profile captures its public web, legal, and security surface. Surfaced as an accel portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Prenav
providers.description: PRENAV, Inc. is a Belmont, California company that automates the visual inspection of large civil and industrial structures using commercially available drones, photogrammetry and deep learning. Its PRENAV.XYZ web platform stitches thousands of drone photographs into a high-resolution 3D point-cloud digital twin, then runs machine-learning models over that twin to detect cracking in concrete, spalling, exposed rebar, cracks in steel and rust, resolving features under 0.2mm and tracking change over time. A second line, Synthetic Imagery as a Service, procedurally renders thousands of annotated photoreal defect images each month to augment a customer's own AI training sets. PRENAV publishes no developer program, no public API, and no machine-readable API description; the product is sold as an enterprise service through a contact form.

providers.name: Rogo
providers.description: Rogo is a New York-based artificial intelligence company building an AI platform purpose-built for the world's leading financial institutions. Founded by Gabriel Stengel, John Willett, and Tumas Rackaitis, Rogo serves 300+ institutions and 35,000+ bankers and investors with AI agents that execute end-to-end financial workflows — producing institutional-grade Excel models, investment memos, diligence materials, and slide decks. Its platform (including the Felix assistant) integrates with firm systems (SharePoint, CRM) and financial data providers (LSEG, FactSet, Capital IQ, PitchBook, Preqin, Dow Jones, SEC filings) and is custom-deployed with enterprise-grade, single-tenant security. Customers include Truist Securities, Nomura, and Baird. Rogo raised a $160M Series D led by Kleiner Perkins. Rogo publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this profile captures its identity and published security/compliance posture.

providers.name: SeekingAlpha
providers.description: Seeking Alpha is a crowd-sourced investment research and analysis platform for stock-market investors, providing breaking financial news, analyst articles, earnings-call transcripts, dividend and quant ratings, stock and ETF screeners, portfolio tracking, and subscription research services (Premium, Pro, and Alpha Picks). Backed by Accel and headquartered in Israel, it serves individual investors worldwide. Added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public first-party developer API is currently published.

providers.name: OnePay
providers.description: OnePay is a Walmart-backed financial technology company that delivers mobile banking and money services through a single consumer app, with banking provided by Coastal Community Bank or Lead Bank (Members FDIC). The app bundles everyday checking and high-yield savings, a Credit Builder loan and credit score monitoring, the OnePay CashRewards Mastercard credit card, buy-now-pay-later (OnePay Later, powered by Klarna/WebBank), a digital wallet, commission-free stock and ETF investing (cleared by DriveWealth), crypto buying (powered by Zero Hash), free tax filing, global transfers (powered by MoneyGram), and cash back tied to Walmart. Originally launched as ONE (One Finance), OnePay is backed by Ribbit Capital and Walmart. It operates a gated developer/partner surface at developer.onepay.com (currently access-controlled) rather than a public API program.

providers.name: QPLIX
providers.description: QPLIX GmbH is a Munich-based wealth management software company offering QPLIX-Q, an all-in-one SaaS platform for professional investors, family offices, asset managers, and banks to consolidate, manage, and report on multi-asset-class portfolios. The platform automates portfolio management, trading and rebalancing, accounting, tax, and client reporting, integrating direct data feeds from 150+ custodian banks (UBS, Julius Baer, Deutsche Bank, and others) and leading market-data providers (LSEG, Moody's, S&P Dow Jones Indices, ISS ESG). QPLIX runs a self-hosted, API-based infrastructure on ISO 27001-certified European data centers, holds an ISAE 3402 attestation, and is registered with Germany's BaFin as an account information service provider (AISP). The company does not publish a public developer API or portal; integrations are delivered as managed add-ons and there is no OpenAPI, SDK, or developer documentation surface.

providers.name: TPG Inc
providers.description: TPG Inc is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The TPG Inc API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Treasury
providers.description: Treasury (treasury.app) is a consumer investing and personal-finance education platform that bills itself as "the first investing platform built for learning as a community" and a "non-judgmental investing community." It pairs creator-led learning communities (workshops, coaching, and discussion forums), commission-free brokerage investing accounts with fractional and recurring investments, and self-guided courses on investing, personal finance, and retirement. Backed by Bloomberg Beta and other investors, Treasury has introduced tens of thousands of new investors to the market. It has no traditional public REST/OpenAPI developer platform, but it does expose an agent-native surface: a hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server at treasury.app/mcp guarded by an OAuth 2.1 authorization server (authorization code + PKCE, dynamic client registration, scope mcp:connect).

providers.name: AgFunder
providers.description: AgFunder is a global agrifood-tech venture capital firm investing in deeptech and foundational technologies across AI, biology, robotics, and climate to advance food, agriculture, and human and planetary health. Founded roughly a decade ago by Michael Dean and Rob Leclerc and headquartered in Silicon Valley with offices in London and Singapore, the firm manages over $300M in assets and has backed more than 100 portfolio companies across four continents. AgFunder also operates AgFunderNews (AFN), the leading agtech and foodtech news and research publication, and publishes market research for the agrifoodtech ecosystem. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead and enriched with the firm's public identity and site properties; AgFunder publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: AI Fund
providers.description: AI Fund is a venture studio founded by Andrew Ng that co-founds and scales AI-powered companies alongside entrepreneurs, venture funds, and corporate partners. Backed by more than $370 million from investors including Sequoia Capital, NEA, Nikkei, and AES, it validates, builds, and scales ventures that tackle real-world problems across emergency response, retail, supply chain, government services, and enterprise productivity. Portfolio companies include Workera, Factored, Workhelix, Profitmind, and IrisGo. AI Fund was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Greylock.

providers.name: California Forever
providers.description: California Forever is a real estate and urban development company founded by Jan Sramek in 2017, backed by prominent Silicon Valley investors including Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Laurene Powell Jobs, Reid Hoffman, Marc Andreessen, and Stripe co-founders Patrick and John Collison. Through its subsidiary Flannery Associates the company assembled roughly 60,000-70,000 acres of land in southeastern Solano County, California, and is planning a new walkable city for up to 400,000 residents alongside the Solano Foundry advanced manufacturing park and the Solano Shipyard. The company describes the effort as a $215 billion private investment intended to create hundreds of thousands of jobs, 170,000+ new homes, and billions in annual tax revenue over 40 years. California Forever is a physical-development and land-use company; it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable interfaces at this time.

providers.name: District Cover
providers.description: District Cover is a commercial insurance managing general agent and surplus-lines broker focused on urban businesses. It underwrites flexible commercial coverage for city-based retailers, restaurants, bakeries, laundromats, dry cleaners, salons, law and medical offices, and multi-location mid-market operators, using block-level risk scoring drawn from crime and fire analytics rather than broad ZIP-code assessments. The platform supports real-time submissions, multi-location quoting, and property-only endorsements, and is distributed to brokers through a licensed producer network operating across multiple U.S. states. District Cover publishes no public API or developer program; broker access is delivered through a hosted Insly portal.

providers.name: Endeavor Catalyst I
providers.description: Endeavor Catalyst is the rules-based, co-investment fund of Endeavor Global, the nonprofit that supports high-impact entrepreneurs worldwide. The fund invests exclusively in companies led by Endeavor Entrepreneurs across Series A through D+ rounds, recycling proceeds back into Endeavor's mission of building entrepreneurial ecosystems in emerging and underserved markets. Endeavor Catalyst I is the first vintage in this fund family; across all vintages the program manages $540M+ in assets with 405+ active investments spanning 35+ markets, including 71 companies valued at $1B+ and 37 realized exits. This profile tracks the firm as a venture-capital entity in the API Evangelist network; it publishes no public API.

providers.name: Marlin Equity Partners
providers.description: Marlin Equity Partners (marlinequity.com) is a global investment firm founded in 2005 and headquartered in Hermosa Beach, California, with an additional office in London. The firm acquires and builds software and technology businesses, partnering with management teams to create strategic value through operational support, organic growth, and add-on acquisitions, with particular focus on financial technology and e-commerce segments. Its portfolio has included companies such as Bazaarvoice, Medius, StarCompliance, Exegy, and Learning Pool. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio-network lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; as a private equity investor rather than a technology service provider, Marlin publishes no public API, developer portal, or technical documentation.

providers.name: nlyte
providers.description: nlyte is an enterprise Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM) software provider, now part of Carrier, that helps organizations discover, model, and manage physical and virtual data-center assets, capacity, power, cooling, connectivity, and operational workflows across facilities. Nlyte products expose REST APIs (including the NgageAPI / Ngauge web service) plus a portfolio of pre-built bi-directional connectors for CMDB, ITSM, service desk, virtualization, and building-management systems. The API is delivered to customers through the Nlyte customer portal rather than a public developer program, so there is no open developer portal, OpenAPI definition, or self-serve sign-up.

providers.name: OnCorps AI
providers.description: OnCorps AI is an agentic AI platform for fund operations at financial institutions, automating complex middle- and back-office tasks through AI agents that predict root causes and reduce time and cost. Its products span NAV oversight, investment operations, reconciliation, financial report review, performance verification, security attribution, cash and positions validation, accounting controls, OTC confirmations, and FX/share-class hedging, plus Deep Industry Research Agents (DIRA) for financial transaction analysis. OnCorps serves asset managers and fund administrators including PIMCO and Natixis, and is SOC 1 and ISO 27001 certified. No public API or developer program is currently published; this profile is maintained as a company record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Rally
providers.description: Rally (Rally Rd.) is an alternative-asset investing platform that lets everyday investors buy and sell equity shares in individual collectible assets — classic cars, watches, fine art, wine, sports memorabilia, trading cards, and other rare items. Rally sources and authenticates each item, files it with the SEC as a regulated offering, splits it into shares in an Initial Offering, and then opens a Bid/Ask secondary market roughly 90 days later so shareholders can trade. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in New York, Rally runs iOS, Android, and web apps and raised a $30M Series B led by Accel in 2021. Rally publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or documentation surface; this profile captures its identity and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Setpoint.io
providers.description: Setpoint is a capital markets operating system for asset-backed finance. It embeds with borrowers and lenders to manage debt facilities — warehouse facilities, forward flow agreements, securitization, and fund/leverage finance — automating collateral verification, data standardization, and reporting across ABS and ABF markets. The platform (Capital OS and Data OS, plus PledgeCheck collateral certification and Setpoint Analytics) manages over $50 billion in financed assets annually. Setpoint is not currently a public API provider; this profile captures the company's identity and public web surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: SmartAsset
providers.description: SmartAsset is a financial technology company that runs the largest online marketplace connecting consumers with fiduciary financial advisors. Its SmartAdvisor matching service pairs more than 50,000 retail investors each month with up to three vetted advisors based on geography, investable assets, and preferences, while the SmartAsset Advisor Marketing Platform (AMP) delivers advisors a subscription stream of qualified referrals plus lead automation that syncs into their CRMs (Salesforce, HubSpot, Wealthbox, Redtail, Zoho, Pipedrive, SmartOffice). SmartAsset also publishes a large library of consumer personal-finance calculators and editorial content across taxes, retirement, mortgages, investing, and banking. Backed by a16z and Y Combinator, SmartAsset is a lead-generation and media business and does not currently expose a public developer API.

providers.name: Techstars Ventures
providers.description: Techstars Ventures is the venture-capital arm of Techstars, the global pre-seed accelerator and investor founded in 2006 in Boulder, Colorado. Techstars backs early-stage founders with capital, three months of intensive mentorship, and access to a worldwide network of investors, operators, and corporate partners across accelerator programs in cities including Boulder, Boston, Chicago, London, New York, and Tokyo. Its portfolio spans fintech, health, critical infrastructure, and software, and includes companies such as Uber, Twilio, ClassPass, DigitalOcean, Chainalysis, and Remitly. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of foundry-group and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Auxmoney
providers.description: Auxmoney (auxmoney GmbH) is a Düsseldorf-based German fintech operating one of Europe's largest online lending marketplaces, connecting consumer and small-business borrowers with private and institutional investors. Its fully digital platform handles personal-loan applications end to end — identity and credit checks, risk scoring, approval within seconds, and disbursement typically within 24 hours — funded by retail investors and institutional capital via its investment arm. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Index Ventures. auxmoney publishes no public developer API or portal; its integration surface is a partner/affiliate program plus internal open-source tooling on GitHub. This profile is maintained by the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Cadre
providers.description: Cadre is a New York-based, technology-driven investment platform that gives individual and institutional investors access to private-market alternatives, historically centered on institutional-quality commercial real estate. Founded in 2014 and backed by investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Thrive Capital, and Slow Ventures, Cadre now operates in partnership with Willow Wealth (Willow Wealth Markets LLC, a FINRA/SIPC broker-dealer formerly known as RealCadre LLC, and Willow Asset Management LLC, an SEC-registered investment adviser) to offer diversified private-market funds alongside traditional stocks and bonds. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; Cadre does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Diligencesquared Inc
providers.description: DiligenceSquared is an AI-powered commercial due diligence and market research platform serving private equity firms, credit investors, and corporate clients. It deploys AI voice agents to run hundreds of simultaneous investor-grade expert interviews, then organizes the findings into structured, fully source-traceable market intelligence for investment decision-making. Backed by Y Combinator, the company operates a customer web application at app.diligencesquared.com and publishes a Vanta-hosted trust center. As of this enrichment pass it exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Experiment
providers.description: Experiment is an online crowdfunding platform for scientific research that connects scientists directly with backers who fund individual studies. Researchers across biology, chemistry, medicine, physics, computer science, paleontology, economics, engineering, and neuroscience post projects with goals and budgets; the public pledges funds, follows lab notes, and shares in the discoveries. Experiment (formerly Microryza) also supports university institutions and dedicated funding programs, and publishes results and updates back to funders. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z, slow-ventures, and y-combinator and added to the API Evangelist network; enrichment found a live consumer website but no public developer API, docs, or well-known surface.

providers.name: Oxford Science Enterprises
providers.description: Oxford Science Enterprises (OSE) is an independent investment company and venture builder that transforms cutting-edge research from the University of Oxford into commercial companies tackling global challenges across deep tech, life sciences, and health tech. Operating on a "find, fund, build" model, OSE provides patient capital and hands-on company-building to Oxford science founders, backing 50+ flagship companies with a net asset value of around £1.3bn alongside 300+ co-investors. Notable outcomes include Oxford Ionics (acquired by IonQ) and Dark Blue Therapeutics. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; OSE is an investor and venture builder and does not publish a public API or developer program.

providers.name: SunGard Data Systems
providers.description: SunGard Data Systems was a software and technology services company that provided software and processing solutions to financial services, education, and the public sector. In November 2015, SunGard was acquired by Fidelity National Information Services (FIS) for approximately $9.1 billion. Key product lines included SunGard Financial Systems (trading, treasury, risk management, capital markets), SunGard AvantGard (cash and liquidity management), SunGard K-12 (student information systems), and SunGard Higher Education (ERP for universities). Post-acquisition, these products were integrated into the FIS portfolio.

providers.name: Animoca Brands
providers.description: Animoca Brands is a Web3 company focused on advancing digital property rights and building the open metaverse through blockchain technology, gaming, and digital assets. Founded in Hong Kong, the company operates a portfolio of consumer products including The Sandbox, Moca Network (digital identity), Open Campus (education), and Anichess, alongside institutional offerings such as Anchorpoint Financial (stablecoins and real-world assets) and NUVA (treasury management). Animoca Brands is also one of the most active investors in Web3, backing 600+ builders across gaming, infrastructure, real-world assets, and digital-ownership platforms. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of the SoftBank Vision Fund and added to the API Evangelist network; Animoca operates primarily as a holding and investment company and does not publish a first-party public developer API.

providers.name: Collision (now Web Summit Vancouver)
providers.description: Collision was the major annual North American technology conference organized by Web Summit, held in Toronto from 2019 through 2024 and widely dubbed the "Olympics of Tech." Beginning in 2025, the event was relocated to the Vancouver Convention Centre and rebranded as Web Summit Vancouver, aligning with the global Web Summit family (Lisbon, Rio, Doha, Qatar). Web Summit Vancouver is contracted through at least 2027 and was held May 27-30, 2025; Web Summit Vancouver 2026 is scheduled for May 11-14, 2026. The Collision brand is retired but this profile is preserved for historical reference. Collision/Web Summit does not publish a public developer REST API; the conference operates speaker, partner, attendee, and press portals.

providers.name: International Development Finance Corporation
providers.description: The United States International Development Finance Corporation (DFC) is a development finance institution and agency of the United States federal government. DFC invests in development projects primarily in lower and middle-income countries, providing secure private investment opportunities for emerging markets. DFC does not currently expose a public developer API portal; transaction-level data is published as downloadable datasets.

providers.name: UBS
providers.description: A Swiss multinational investment bank and financial services company and the world's largest wealth manager. UBS exposes a multi-ecosystem developer platform at developer.ubs.com covering retail banking, mortgages, QR billing, EU PSD2 open banking, Swiss TWINT payments, corporate bLink connectivity, and the enterprise UBS Partner / KeyPort offering.

providers.name: American Operator
providers.description: American Operator acquires small businesses from retiring owners and pairs them with vetted operators through an operate-to-own model, where operators begin with a 10% stake on day one and follow a defined path to majority ownership. The company runs an "Exit Confidently" program that gives retiring owners all-cash closes, and supports its operators with hands-on guidance, industry advisors, and a governance structure. Backed by 8vc, American Operator publishes a marketing and applicant website but exposes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or documentation surface as of this profile.

providers.name: Capitolis
providers.description: Capitolis is a financial technology company for the capital markets that helps banks and institutional investors optimize how capital is used across their trading portfolios. Its two flagship offerings are a Capital Marketplace that connects banks with origination capabilities to institutional providers of capital, and a Portfolio Optimization service that offsets redundant and offsetting derivatives positions to reduce capital requirements, counterparty exposure, and systemic risk. By combining technology with financial expertise, Capitolis aims to create a safer, more efficient financial system and broaden access to more diversified pools of capital. The platform is delivered as a secure, login-gated web application to regulated financial institutions rather than as a public developer API.

providers.name: Digital Currency Group
providers.description: Digital Currency Group (DCG) is a cryptocurrency and blockchain holding and venture company founded in 2015 by Barry Silbert and headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut. DCG builds, incubates, and invests in companies across the digital asset ecosystem, including subsidiaries such as Grayscale Investments and Foundry. It operates as an investor and parent company rather than a direct API provider; this network profile tracks DCG's public web presence and corporate surface. Surfaced as a portfolio company of bain-capital-ventures. Sector: fintech / digital assets.

providers.name: Enfusion
providers.description: Enfusion is a cloud-native, front-to-back investment management platform for hedge funds and asset managers, unifying portfolio management (PMS), order and execution management (OEMS), pre- and post-trade compliance, a unified IBOR/ABOR accounting book of record, and analytics on a single SaaS database. It serves over 1,000 clients across 30 countries, offers direct connectivity to 300+ liquidity sources via FIX, and maintains a 4M+ instrument security master. Enfusion was acquired by Clearwater Analytics (CWAN) in 2025; the enfusion.com domain now redirects to cwan.com, where Enfusion is offered as a product line. There is no public developer portal or open API specification: the platform API and knowledge base are gated behind the client web application and Zendesk help center. This profile was surfaced as an ICONIQ Capital portfolio lead and enriched from public marketing, support, and legal surfaces.

providers.name: METYCLE
providers.description: METYCLE is a Cologne, Germany-based digital B2B marketplace and AI-powered trading platform for the international secondary (scrap) metal industry, connecting suppliers and buyers of recycled metals - copper, aluminum, zinc, nickel, lead and magnesium - across borders. Operated by METYCLE GmbH and led by managing directors Rafael Suchan and Sebastian Brenner, the company raised a 14.1M euro Series A round to expand its platform for transparent, sustainable global metal trade and to advance circular-economy sourcing of secondary metals. Its customer platform supports biddable listings, product discovery and trade execution. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a company/provider record; METYCLE currently exposes no public developer API.

providers.name: Realty Mogul
providers.description: RealtyMogul is a real estate crowdfunding and investment platform that gives individual and institutional investors online access to commercial real estate opportunities, including private placements, 1031 Exchange properties, and Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs). The company performs due diligence on sponsors, business plans, and properties, and provides members with a secure website and online tools to evaluate and invest in professionally managed real estate. RealtyMogul publishes no public API or developer program.

providers.name: Withco
providers.description: Withco, now operating as With at with.us (the original with.co domain 301-redirects there), is rebuilding main street one share at a time. The company helps small business owners buy the commercial buildings they operate in, stacking the owner's investment, seller financing, and community investor capital to meet the deal price, grounding offers in comparable sales, and giving each business a public investor page to tell its story to potential backers. Withco is a consumer/community real-estate platform and publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: xRocket Exchange API
providers.description: Telegram-native centralized crypto exchange (CEX) developer program exposing a REST Exchange API for trading and market data (with a WebSocket stream) and a REST Pay API for payments, cheques, invoices, transfers and withdrawals. Bearer-token authenticated with public read endpoints and Swagger/OpenAPI contracts.

providers.name: Dow Jones Developer Platform
providers.description: Dow Jones is a financial news and information provider that publishes The Wall Street Journal, Barron's, MarketWatch, and Financial News, and operates a portfolio of professional information services including Factiva, Dow Jones Newswires, and Dow Jones Risk and Compliance. The Dow Jones Developer Platform exposes APIs and data services that give developers programmatic access to Dow Jones content, market data, company and people intelligence, and risk and compliance datasets.

providers.name: Bitculator
providers.description: Modern cryptocurrency REST API providing programmatic read access to crypto market data including coins, prices, markets, exchanges, wallets, global market data, sentiment, indicators, liquidations, conversions, calculators, editorial content, alarms, and webhooks. Version 1.0.0 with 70+ endpoints across 15 groups.

providers.name: Curie.Bio
providers.description: Curie.Bio is a seed-stage biotech venture firm and drug-discovery co-pilot co-founded by Zach Weinberg (founder of Flatiron Health), Alexis Borisy, and Christoph Lengauer. It pairs seed investment — typically $5M-$7M initial checks, backed by a $380M pro-rata Series A follow-on fund — with hands-on scientific and operational support from a team of experienced drug hunters, helping therapeutics founders design their science and move programs into the clinic and toward a strong next round of financing. Curie.Bio has raised close to $1B and is backed by GV, a16z, and ARCH Venture Partners. It operates as a company/investor profile in the API Evangelist network; it publishes no public developer API or platform, so most technical API artifacts are not applicable to this provider.

providers.name: Deutsche Bank
providers.description: Deutsche Bank is a global financial institution that offers a wide range of banking services to individuals, businesses, and institutions. The bank provides services such as retail banking, investment banking, asset management, and wealth management. Deutsche Bank is known for its expertise in international markets and has a strong presence in Europe, the Americas, and Asia. The Deutsche Bank Developer Portal publishes Open Banking and Beyond-PSD2 APIs for partners and developers.

providers.name: EVEDEX — Crypto Exchange: Forex, Indexes & Metals
providers.description: EVEDEX is a hybrid, self-custodial crypto derivatives exchange built on Arbitrum Layer 3, offering perpetual futures, P2P, and copy trading. It exposes a REST API (Auth, Exchange, and Market Data services), a Centrifugo WebSocket real-time API, OpenAPI/Swagger contracts, an official Node.js/TypeScript SDK, and an llms.txt agent-native surface.

providers.name: RockFi
providers.description: RockFi is a French private wealth management firm positioning itself as a modern family office, pairing experienced private-banking advisors with technology to serve high-net-worth entrepreneurs, executives, athletes, and independent professionals. Its fixed-fee model offers life insurance (France and Luxembourg), structured funds, private equity, SCPI real estate, PEA and securities accounts, customized investment mandates, and consolidated real-time portfolio monitoring, tax optimization, and wealth-transmission planning. Registered with ORIAS (23004556) under ACPR and AMF oversight. Backed by Partech. No public developer API is currently published; this profile has been enriched from the public site.

providers.name: Argus Software
providers.description: Argus Software (ARGUS) is a commercial real estate software provider whose products are the industry standard for cash-flow modeling, valuation, asset and investment management, and development-project appraisal for owners, investors, lenders, and advisors. Founded in Houston, Texas and acquired by Altus Group in 2011, the ARGUS product line is now delivered through Altus Group as the ARGUS Intelligence platform and includes ARGUS Enterprise, ARGUS EstateMaster, ARGUS Developer, ARGUS Taliance, ARGUS ValueInsight, ARGUS Voyanta, and Forbury. ARGUS software is used across the global commercial real estate industry to underwrite acquisitions, perform discounted cash-flow analysis, run portfolio and fund analytics, and standardize valuations. As of this enrichment pass ARGUS exposes no public developer portal, OpenAPI description, or self-service API program; its cloud platform is accessed through the Altus Platform / ARGUS Cloud portal.

providers.name: Ethic
providers.description: Ethic is an SEC-registered technology-driven asset manager that helps financial advisors and institutions build and manage highly customized, values-aligned, and tax-smart investment portfolios at scale. Its platform centralizes client portfolio management across direct indexing, model portfolios, and unified managed accounts (UMAs), letting advisors personalize holdings to individual values and tax situations. Ethic is a private, advisor- and institution-facing platform and publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or webhooks as of this profiling.

providers.name: Fundable
providers.description: Fundable is a software-as-a-service fundraising platform for startups, operated as part of the Startups.com family and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead of 500 Global. Fundable helps founders start and manage a professional raise to attract accredited investors, providing a secure investor data room, investor browsing and discovery tools, and email outreach templates across Self-Managed and Funding Accelerator Premium tiers. The platform reports more than $700 million in funding commitments across 20,000+ accredited investors. Fundable is not a registered broker-dealer and does not execute securities transactions or offer investment advice. As of this enrichment pass Fundable publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable specification, so this profile captures company identity, published policy/support surfaces, and a probed domain-security posture rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Gyde
providers.description: Gyde is an AI-native health insurance brokerage, founded in 2025 and headquartered in Austin, Texas with an office in New York City. Gyde partners with established insurance agencies through acquisition, embedding AI-powered tools and operational support so brokers can guide clients through insurance, health, and wealth decisions at greater scale. Its products include Gia, an AI assistant that handles client outreach, scheduling, and questions over SMS and voice around the clock, and GydeOS, a broker operating system providing client summaries, conversation transcripts, campaign management, and an AI co-pilot. Gyde launched publicly in January 2026 with $60M in financing led by Lightspeed Venture Partners. The company does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs; this profile tracks its identity and public web properties in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Hustle Fund
providers.description: Hustle Fund is a pre-seed and seed-stage venture capital firm that invests in "hilariously early" software and technology startups, backing founders often within one or two meetings. Beyond writing early checks through its funds and angel investor network, Hustle Fund publishes tactical, BS-free educational content and newsletters for founders (The Founder Playbook) and investors (Small Bets), and runs programs that help operators learn to angel invest. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of foundry-group. Sector: venture-capital.

providers.name: MayStreet
providers.description: MayStreet is a low-latency market data infrastructure vendor founded in 2012 and acquired by London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) in May 2022, with maystreet.com now redirecting into LSEG's data feeds pages. The company captures full-depth exchange feeds in raw PCAP form across 300+ venues and sells them through the Bellport feed handler (C++ library, on-premises or managed), a 20+ petabyte Market Data Lake of historical tick data (PCAP/Parquet queried via Athena SQL and the Medusa Python client), the cloud Analytics Workbench (JupyterLab), and the High Performance Query (HPQ) streaming WebSocket API for near-time data. Access is sales-gated and entitlement-managed with no self-serve signup or public developer portal; the public API surface that exists is documented through example "springboard" repositories on the MayStreet GitHub organization rather than a docs site.

providers.name: Neptune Networks
providers.description: Neptune Networks operates Neptune, an institutional fixed-income pre-trade data platform that delivers real-time dealer axes and bond inventory directly into buy-side workflows. Aggregating structured data from 34 global banks, the network surfaces roughly 110k bonds per day at around $2.2T daily gross notional across 33 currencies, helping asset managers identify liquidity opportunities before they trade. Originally an independent, bank-owned utility backed by Anthemis, Neptune is now operated as RealQ, the data-solutions arm of Liquidnet Fixed Income (part of TP ICAP Group). Connectivity is institutional and permissioned - a browser web app, OMS/EMS integrations, FIX, a REST API, FTP/SSH drop copy, and AWS cloud data transfer - with no public developer portal, published OpenAPI, or open SDKs.

providers.name: Second Measure
providers.description: Bloomberg Second Measure provides alternative data analytics for investors, turning billions of anonymized U.S. consumer card-transaction purchases into daily insights on the performance of thousands of public and private companies and brands. It is a Bloomberg product delivered primarily through the Bloomberg Terminal (ALTD and ECAN commands) and via aggregated and transaction-level data feeds, with 2-, 3-, and 7-day delivery lags that support intra-quarter earnings forecasting and investment monitoring. Second Measure was founded as a Bessemer Venture Partners portfolio company and acquired by Bloomberg in 2020. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification; access is gated through Bloomberg data products rather than a self-serve web API.

providers.name: Axoni
providers.description: Axoni is a New York-based financial data infrastructure company that provides real-time, automated replication of data between institutions, reducing reconciliations, data pipeline management cost, and operational risk across capital markets. Its platform lets banks, asset managers, and market infrastructure providers rapidly deploy critical financial networks and share post-trade data in real time. Axoni is used by leading institutions including JPMorgan, Deutsche Bank, BlackRock, and Citigroup, and has been recognized by Risk.net, the A-Team Group, and Forbes Fintech 50. The company is SOC 2 Type 2 certified and is backed by a16z and DCVC. Axoni does not currently publish a public developer portal, API reference, or SDKs; its documentation surface is access-gated to customers.

providers.name: Bolsai
providers.description: Brazilian financial-market data REST API serving equities, real-estate funds (FIIs), fundamentals, dividends, financial statements, and macroeconomic series sourced from official feeds (B3, CVM, BCB).

providers.name: Freeport Markets
providers.description: Freeport Markets is a Y Combinator-backed fintech and crypto trading platform offering 24/7 self-custody access to stocks, crypto, commodities, forex, rates, perpetual futures and pre-IPO shares, with leverage and AI analysts that turn social and financial media into a real-time feed of market-moving news and actionable trade ideas. The consumer product is delivered primarily through iOS and Android apps and emphasizes self-custody, "smart money" signal tracking (insiders, politicians, hedge funds and social media), and unified DeFi opportunities in a single interface. This profile was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Freeport Markets does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, or developer documentation at this time.

providers.name: Signal Advisors
providers.description: Signal Advisors is a financial technology company building an integrated software platform for independent financial advisors and insurance professionals. The Signal Platform consolidates annuity, life insurance, and wealth management workflows into a single system, replacing the traditional Independent Marketing Organization (IMO) model. Product lines include Signal Annuity (quoting, design, and submission), Signal Wealth (portfolio and compliance management), and Signal Life (life-insurance workflow automation), with features such as real-time carrier status updates (TrueStatus), fast commission payouts (TruePay), AI-generated policy summaries, and integrated householding. The company operates a closed, account-based advisor portal and does not publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Tradeblock
providers.description: Tradeblock (operated by Astrolab, Inc. d/b/a Tradeblock, founded 2019) is a mobile-first, peer-to-peer sneaker trading marketplace that lets collectors use their sneakers as currency. Members build a Closet and Wishlist, browse a feed of public and private trade offers, and swap sneakers with other collectors, balancing uneven trades with cash. Every trade routes through Tradeblock's authentication centers, where shoes are verified for authenticity before shipping to each party. The service also surfaces supply-and-demand signals for individual sneaker models. Tradeblock is a consumer app (iOS, Android, and web) backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Trinity Ventures, and DCVC; it does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Withcoverage
providers.description: WithCoverage is a technology-driven risk management and commercial insurance platform that aims to replace the traditional insurance broker for growing businesses. It pairs a team of insurance advisors, claims specialists, and attorneys with an AI-powered digital platform to analyze policies, reduce premiums, manage certificates of insurance, and handle claims proactively as companies scale. Headquartered in New York City and backed by venture investors including 8vc, WithCoverage operates in the insurtech sector. This API Evangelist profile was created as a portfolio lead and enriched by the pipeline; the company currently exposes no public developer API surface (client access is through the app.withcoverage.com web application).

providers.name: Axend
providers.description: Axend is an online investment marketplace that connects individual investors in Latin America with private company and project investment opportunities. Operating as an aggregator, it partners with allied investment platforms and earns commissions when users register or transact through them. The platform provides portfolio-building tools to analyze projects by industry, timeline, and expected return, personalized support for managing capital, and dynamic reconfiguration so investors can adjust their preferences to optimize financial performance. Axend is a portfolio company of 500 Global. It exposes no public API, developer documentation, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: Forwardlane
providers.description: ForwardLane Technologies builds Signal Studio, a decision intelligence platform that transforms enterprise data into auditable actions rather than dashboards. Users ask questions in natural language and receive Next Best Actions with complete audit trails in seconds, powered by a semantic data layer, multi-agent AI orchestration, a no-code signal builder, and in-database processing so data never leaves the customer environment. Validated across eight years of Fortune 500 production, Signal Studio serves financial services, private credit and private equity, real estate, energy and oil and gas, and government, with BYOK support for any LLM, cloud, or inference provider. Led by CEO Nathan Stevenson. ForwardLane exposes no public developer API surface; this profile captures the company's public identity and security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Metalshub
providers.description: Metalshub (Metals Hub GmbH) is a Berlin-based digital platform for the metals, mining, and recycling industries, enabling over 2,800 industry participants to buy, sell, and trade raw materials online. Its procurement, sales, and tolling solutions help companies source ferroalloys, minor metals, noble alloys, and recycled materials, discover new suppliers and customers, run digital tenders and auctions, and manage the full transaction lifecycle from negotiation to contract. Backed by Point Nine and other investors, Metalshub operates a login-gated trading application at trade.metals-hub.com. No public API or developer program was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Skience (The Athene Group)
providers.description: Skience, a product of The Athene Group, is a wealth management technology company that delivers a Salesforce-based platform for firms undergoing digital transformation. Its platform serves broker-dealers, registered investment advisors (RIAs), and enterprise wealth management organizations with digital client and advisor onboarding, automated account opening, data management and aggregation, and advisor productivity tooling built natively on the Salesforce Financial Services Cloud ecosystem. Skience is backed by Insight Partners and operates as a private SaaS provider; it does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal, but it does maintain a SafeBase-hosted trust center documenting SOC 2 Type 2 and SOC 2 + HITRUST attestations and a responsible disclosure program.

providers.name: Team8
providers.description: Team8 is an Israel-based venture group that both creates and invests in companies, operating as a company-building foundry alongside a traditional venture-capital fund. Founded in 2014 by veterans of Israel's elite military technology units, the firm builds and backs startups across four domains — Cybersecurity, Software Infrastructure, Fintech, and Digital Health — and believes the greatest successes emerge at their intersections. Team8 pairs founders with capital, deep operating expertise, a community of enterprise CISOs and executives, and a hands-on venture-creation methodology it calls "success by design." It does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures Team8's corporate, portfolio, and insights web presence, surfaced into the API Evangelist network as a Bessemer Venture Partners portfolio lead.

providers.name: Altvia
providers.description: Altvia is fund management software purpose-built for private capital markets, serving private equity, venture capital, fund of funds, real estate, hedge funds, family offices, and placement agents. Built on the Salesforce platform, Altvia unifies a purpose-built CRM, a virtual data room (VDR) and LP investor portal, analytics and reporting, and an AI assistant (AIMe) into one system that spans the full fund lifecycle — capital raising, investor relations, and deal management. Founded in 2006 and based in Broomfield, Colorado, Altvia was acquired by Marlin Equity Partners in 2022. The company exposes no public developer/API portal; integrations are delivered through the platform and the Salesforce ecosystem.

providers.name: EZ Farming
providers.description: EZ Farming is an agriculture investment and farm-ownership platform that lets individuals start or co-own a working farm without doing the day-to-day work themselves. Members can buy land in the EZFarming farm estate, join a farmer cooperative to co-own a farm alongside other investors, buy produce directly from managed farms, or invest in agricultural projects for returns. Backed by 500 Global, the company packages land acquisition, farm management, and produce offtake into a single managed offering aimed at first-time farm owners and agriculture investors.

providers.name: Finverse
providers.description: Finverse is a unified open finance API platform providing aggregated access to banking data, payments, and financial services across Asia-Pacific. Often described as the Plaid for Asia, it connects to over 40 banks across Hong Kong, Singapore, Philippines, Vietnam, and other Southeast Asian markets.

providers.name: High Alpha
providers.description: High Alpha is a venture firm and venture studio based in Indianapolis, Indiana that creates and funds early-stage B2B SaaS companies. Through its Capital arm it makes pre-seed to Series B investments across the United States, and through its Studio it co-founds companies with entrepreneurs, providing design, brand, marketing, recruiting, product design, and go-to-market services. Founded by ExactTarget co-founder and CEO Scott Dorsey along with Eric Tobias, Mike Fitzgerald, and Studio Science founder Kristian Andersen, High Alpha pioneered the venture studio model and publishes the annual SaaS Benchmarks Report. Studio and portfolio companies include Salesloft, Lessonly, Attentive, Logik.ai, LogicGate, Dwolla, Zylo, and project44.

providers.name: Laureate Education
providers.description: Laureate Education, Inc. is a for-profit higher-education network founded in 1989 as Sylvan Learning Systems and renamed Laureate Education in May 2004. At its 2017 IPO peak the company operated more than 200 campuses across 28 countries serving over one million students; it became only the third B Corporation to go public when it listed on NASDAQ (ticker: LAUR) on 1 February 2017. Between 2018 and 2021 Laureate executed one of the largest sector-wide divestiture programs in the history of higher education, exiting Brazil (sold to Ânima Holding for ~$765M), the United States (Walden University sold to Adtalem for $1.48B), Australia / New Zealand (sold to Strategic Education), Chile (Universidad Andrés Bello transferred to Fundación Educación y Cultura in September 2020), Spain, Portugal, Morocco, Turkey, Malaysia, China, Italy, Cyprus and the United Kingdom — returning $1.29B to shareholders in October 2021. After the divestiture cycle Laureate continued as a pure-play Mexico / Peru operator with five remaining institutions and approximately 460,000 students. In May 2024 the company was acquired by an investor group led by the International Finance Corporation (IFC, a member of the World Bank Group) and Sterling Capital, taking Laureate Education private and delisting it from NASDAQ. The company is headquartered at 1000 Brickell Avenue, Suite 715, Miami, FL. Laureate does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, webhook surface, or status page. There is no Laureate Education GitHub organization. This profile therefore captures the corporate surface — institutions, divestiture history, leadership, investor status, news — rather than a programmable interface. The five remaining campus-network institutions each publish their own consumer-facing websites (UVM, UNITEC in Mexico; UPC, UPN, Cibertec in Peru) but none expose machine-readable APIs documented from the parent.

providers.name: Zag Bio
providers.description: Zag Bio is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing thymus-targeted therapies for autoimmune diseases. The company engineers bifunctional antibodies that deliver self-antigens to antigen-presenting cells in the thymus, harnessing the body's natural process of central immune tolerance so developing immune cells learn to recognize, tolerate, and protect the body's own tissues. Its pipeline includes ZAG-101, a candidate for Type 1 Diabetes. Founded and incubated by Polaris Partners, Zag Bio launched publicly in October 2025 with an $80M Series A. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a Lightspeed Venture Partners portfolio company; as a therapeutics developer it publishes no public API or developer platform at this time.

providers.name: Adanos Market Sentiment API
providers.description: Key-authenticated REST/JSON API for financial market sentiment analytics across Reddit, X.com, news, and Polymarket, plus stock news and crypto sentiment. Provides Buzz Score, Trend Detection, and directional Sentiment signals for traders, fintech, quant/research teams, and AI agents.

providers.name: Alliance DAO
providers.description: Alliance (Alliance DAO) is a leading crypto, fintech, and AI startup accelerator. Its cohort-based program pairs two weeks of in-person onboarding in New York City with eight weeks of remote acceleration, offering mentorship, lectures, weekly check-ins, and a Demo Day pitch event. Alliance invests $500,000 per startup and runs three cohorts per year. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Initialized Capital, Alliance publishes no public API or developer platform; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: DCG
providers.description: Digital Currency Group (DCG) is a crypto-industry venture and holding company that describes itself as the enduring investor and operator of the crypto industry. Investing in digital currencies and blockchain since 2012, DCG has built a portfolio of 200+ equity investments, 50+ fund investments, and 30+ token and digital-asset positions across 25+ countries. It owns and operates category-leading subsidiaries including Grayscale (crypto asset management), Foundry (mining and staking infrastructure), CoinDesk (media, data and events), Genesis (institutional financial services), Luno (consumer wallet), HQ, and TradeBlock. DCG is a corporate holding and investment company and does not publish a public developer API; this profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead.

providers.name: E-3 Tech
providers.description: E3Tech (E-3 Tech) is an investment firm that partners with entrepreneurs through programmatic M&A and technology amplification, providing private-equity-style investment in profitable service-industry platforms while letting founders retain control and preserve their entrepreneurial culture. It combines strategic acquisitions, operational enhancements, and technology to drive growth across multi-trade construction services, marketing agencies, managed service providers, wealth management, pharmaceutical services, and vegetation management. Surfaced as an a16z-associated portfolio lead and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; as an investment/advisory firm it publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: Homeday
providers.description: Homeday is a German proptech real estate brokerage founded in 2015 and headquartered in Berlin, combining a nationwide network of local partner brokers with digital tools to help owners sell, buyers purchase, and both finance residential property across Germany. Its consumer products include free online and in-person property valuation, full-service sales brokerage, buyer representation, mortgage and financing brokerage through partner banks, and the Preisatlas transparent real estate price map for Germany. Homeday is backed by 500 Global and other investors. The company runs an active engineering organization on GitHub (homeday-de) publishing internal tooling, a Vue component library, design assets, and Ruby clients for third-party real estate APIs (ImmobilienScout24, onOffice), but does not currently publish a first-party public developer API or OpenAPI specification. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio lead and enriched with identity, link-property, and domain-security signals.

providers.name: LJ Hooker
providers.description: LJ Hooker is one of the largest residential and commercial real estate brokerage and property management networks in Australia and New Zealand. Founded in Maroubra, Sydney in 1928, the franchise network reports 390 businesses and around 4,000 sales professionals, property managers and support staff, facilitated more than AUD$20 billion in property transactions during 2024, and manages roughly 100,000 properties valued at about AUD$82 billion on behalf of investors. It operates across residential sales and rentals (ljhooker.com.au), commercial (ljhcommercial.com.au), rural (ljhrural.com.au), land and projects (ljhland.com.au) and New Zealand (ljhooker.co.nz). LJ Hooker sits at the agency layer of the Australian property value chain — below the REA Group / Domain portal duopoly that distributes its listings, and upstream of PEXA electronic conveyancing and the PropTrack / CoreLogic valuation data concentration. Its API posture is honestly stated as none-published: there is no developer portal, no published API documentation, no API terms of use and no partner or data-feed programme on any LJ Hooker domain. The only programmatic surface located is an undocumented, vendor-operated website backend at api01.ljx.com.au, generated by OpenAPI Generator and consumed by the Agentpoint-built property search front end; that OpenAPI definition is not published. RESO — the Real Estate Standards Organization Web API and Data Dictionary — is a North American, NAR-driven regime with no Australian footprint, and LJ Hooker appears nowhere in the RESO certificates directory.

providers.name: WithAI
providers.description: WithAI is a San Francisco-based Y Combinator (Spring 2026) company building Multiplier, a secure AI platform for institutional investors and independent equity hedge funds. Multiplier unifies structured data, unstructured data, AI agents, human work, and firm knowledge so investment teams can research stocks and manage portfolios more efficiently, with an integration ecosystem spanning Bloomberg, FactSet, Enfusion, Snowflake, and other market data and infrastructure platforms. WithAI does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or documentation.

providers.name: Arq
providers.description: Arq (formerly DolarApp) is a Latin American cross-border fintech app that gives travelers, investors, and professionals digital dollar and digital euro accounts at real market rates without hidden fees. Founded in 2021, the mobile-first platform offers currency conversion, a borderless payment card, global accounts to send and receive international payments, bill payment, PIX transfers, stock and ETF investing, and high-yield Trade and Save accounts, plus ARQ Premium and Prestige tiers. Arq raised $70M from Sequoia Capital and Founders Fund and serves over 2 million users across the Americas. Arq is a consumer mobile product and does not publish a public API or developer portal; this profile captures its verified public identity and web surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Cocos Capital
providers.description: Cocos Capital is an Argentine investech and online broker (ALyC, founded 2021 in Buenos Aires) offering a 100% digital investment platform for retail investors. Through its mobile app and website, users open an account and trade Argentine stocks, CEDEARs, sovereign and corporate bonds, mutual funds, the MEP dollar, US stocks via an international account, and crypto, with a fast onboarding experience aimed at making investing accessible to everyone ("Invertir es para todos"). Cocos is registered as an ALyC and regulated by Argentina's Comision Nacional de Valores (CNV), settles through the BYMA group, and has surpassed 300,000 accounts. Cocos publishes no official public API for developers; the client libraries that exist (e.g. pyCocos) are unofficial, community-built and reverse-engineered from the app, so they are recorded here as third-party and unsupported.

providers.name: Indian Energy Exchange
providers.description: Indian Energy Exchange (IEX) is India's largest electricity trading platform, operating a nationwide automated exchange for the physical delivery of electricity, renewable energy, and certificates. IEX runs Day-Ahead, Real-Time, Term-Ahead, Renewable Energy Certificate and Energy Saving Certificate market segments, matching buy and sell bids across a member network of distribution utilities, industrial and commercial consumers, and power generators. For members with sophisticated trading needs IEX offers a members-only trading API (currently for the iDAM and RTM segments) supporting order placement, trade-data retrieval and real-time monitoring for automated and high-frequency trading; access is provisioned to registered members rather than published as a public developer portal. Surfaced as a portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Personal Capital
providers.description: Personal Capital is a digital wealth management and personal finance company, now operating as an Empower company, that pairs free online money-management tools with paid registered-investment-adviser services. Its Personal Capital / Empower Personal Dashboard app lets individuals link bank, brokerage, retirement, and loan accounts to track net worth, analyze investment fees, plan for retirement, and manage cash flow, while Personal Capital Advisors Corporation (an SEC-registered investment adviser) offers human financial advisors and managed portfolios for clients who link at least $100,000 in investable assets. Personal Capital was acquired by Empower Retirement (Great-West Lifeco / Power Corporation) in 2020. The company is consumer-facing and, as of this enrichment pass, does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal.

providers.name: Powerup Money
providers.description: PowerUp Money is an India-based mutual fund advisory app that helps retail investors select, monitor, and rebalance their mutual fund portfolios. It is operated by a SEBI-registered Investment Advisor (RIA No. INA000019798) and BSE member (IA-BSE Membership No. 2465), and describes itself as "India's trusted Mutual Fund Advisory App" serving 900,000+ investors. Consumer-facing features include portfolio performance analysis, fund recommendations (start/pause/exit SIP guidance), monthly portfolio reports, and Elite membership tools such as Power Rank fund selection, Rank Trends monitoring, and Power Rebalancing for tax-efficient quarterly adjustments. It is distributed as iOS and Android mobile apps; no public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface was found. Added to the API Evangelist network as an Accel portfolio company.

providers.name: Sav Technologies Limited
providers.description: Sav Technologies Limited operates Sav (sav.money), a UAE-based intelligent financial platform that lets users track, save, invest, and grow their wealth across accounts. Sav offers a suite of consumer products including Gold (physical gold investment from AED 10), MyMoney (financial management and savings), Card (a prepaid card with cashback), Wealth (investing), Sav Pro (premium membership), and an upcoming Credit product. Sav describes itself as extending the APIs and technology components of licensed financial services providers to its users. It is a 500 Global portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass, Sav publishes a consumer app and marketing site but no public developer API, API documentation, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: SiamSquared
providers.description: SiamSquared Technologies (Thailand) Co., Ltd. is the Bangkok-based company behind StockRadars (stockradars.co), a retail stock-investment analysis platform branded "investing made simple." StockRadars offers mobile apps (iOS and Android, including a paid StockRadars PLUS tier) and a web app for the Thai stock market, with features such as customizable screening "radars," Top100 rankings, income-statement views, shareholder tracking, volume analysis, real-time price alerts, and an in-house news feed (stockradars.news). The company is a 500 Global portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass StockRadars publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or API documentation — it is a consumer-facing application, so most machine-readable API artifacts are not applicable and this profile captures identity plus a domain-security probe.

providers.name: Theorem
providers.description: Theorem builds machine-learning-powered credit underwriting infrastructure for consumer debt markets. Since 2014 the company has priced and purchased billions of dollars in loan volume, powering one of the longest-running investment programs in the market. Its products deliver instant, API-driven credit assessments to lending originators (Custom Loan Integration Programs, or CLIP), score default risk down to individual loan cashflows (Theorem Loan Score, or TLS), and package loans into credit products for capital-market investors (Securitization as a Service). The API is a private, partner-onboarded B2B integration arranged through the partnerships team; there is no public developer portal, published OpenAPI specification, or self-service sign-up. Theorem is backed by Initialized Capital and operates from Silicon Valley, New York City, and Dallas.

providers.name: WSFS Financial
providers.description: WSFS Financial Corporation is a multibillion-dollar financial services company headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware. Its primary subsidiary WSFS Bank has operated since 1832, making it one of the oldest banks in the United States. As of March 31, 2026 the company reported $22.1 billion in assets and $97.6 billion in assets under management and administration across 114 offices in six states. Business lines include personal banking, small business and commercial banking, treasury management, WSFS Mortgage, WSFS Wealth Management, Bryn Mawr Trust (acquired 2022), WSFS Institutional Services, and the Cash Connect ATM-as-a-service business that provides cash logistics and vault cash to independent ATM operators. WSFS does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specifications, or SDKs; all APIs are bilateral treasury / cash management integrations delivered through Enhanced Business Online Banking, ACH/wire file feeds, and the Cash Connect partner portal.

providers.name: Capstack
providers.description: Capstack Technologies operates a digital bank-to-bank marketplace that lets banks, credit unions, and other financial institutions trade whole loans and loan participations, access liquidity, and manage portfolio concentration risk. Founded in 2023 and headquartered in Miami, FL, the SaaS platform integrates with originating banks' core banking systems and loan-origination systems (LOS) to surface loans available for syndication, then lets participating institutions search by criteria, ask questions live, and submit bids. It adds loan servicing (payment processing, remittance reporting, loan status tracking) and real-time portfolio analytics, specializing in commercial real estate, multifamily residential, and farmland loans. The marketplace has featured over $2B in assets across 200+ registered banks and credit unions. Capstack is backed by Cowboy Ventures and Citi Ventures. This is a private enterprise platform accessed via a demo/onboarding flow; no public developer API, SDKs, or documentation are published at this time.

providers.name: Arteria AI
providers.description: Arteria AI is an enterprise AI company for financial services that positions itself as the agentic backbone of financial services operations. Its platform automates document-intensive workflows across the institutional client lifecycle for tier-one global financial institutions: OTC derivatives and ISDA onboarding, prime brokerage, securities services and custody, corporate and commercial lending, trade confirmations, securities lending and repo, regulatory reporting, and post-transaction loan compliance. The platform spans four layers (data, component, agentic, and workflow), combining no-code configuration, automated document generation, intelligent extraction with zero-shot models, clause comparison and decisioning, and controlled agentic orchestration. Arteria AI is SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certified. It does not publish a public API or developer portal; this profile captures the company identity, domain-security posture, and published compliance certifications.

providers.name: FanCraze
providers.description: FanCraze is an International Cricket Council (ICC) officially licensed platform for cricket collectibles, trading, and fantasy gaming, serving more than 500,000 cricket fans worldwide. Its flagship products are Grails, a digital collectibles experience where fans pull officially licensed ICC player cards (Common through Legendary), trade them with other fans, and complete themed sets; and Matchday, a free-to-play fantasy cricket game where fans build squads from their collectibles and compete on live challenges tied to real ICC tournaments including Men's and Women's Cricket World Cups, T20 World Cups, and U-19 World Cups. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners and is backed by investors including Tiger Global, Sequoia, Coatue, Dapper Labs, and Coinbase Ventures. FanCraze operates as a consumer (B2C) mobile and web app and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this profile captures its public web identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Matcherino
providers.description: Matcherino is an esports crowdfunding and tournament-management platform that provides monetization infrastructure for competitive gaming events of every scale, from college clubs to stadium finals. Its stack covers prize-pool crowdfunding, brackets, player signups, ticketing and entry fees, streaming overlays, sponsor activation, and a publisher dashboard for distributing cash and in-game prizes. Matcherino handles global payouts to organizers and winners across 120+ countries with tax-form collection, and surfaces real-time analytics for organizers, sponsors, and publishers. The company reports having paid out more than $5.2M across 14,000+ tournaments. Matcherino is a Techstars-backed company; it does not currently publish a public API or developer platform.

providers.name: PortF
providers.description: PortF is an AI-powered portfolio monitoring platform for private equity, venture capital, and institutional investors. It automates investment data collection and reporting by extracting qualitative and quantitative data from emails, documents, and 25+ connected systems (Excel, OneDrive, SharePoint, SSO, Salesforce, FIS Global, Xero, QuickBooks, Sage, and NetSuite), then consolidates financial, ESG, and impact data into a single source of truth with real-time analytics, IRR benchmarking, and agentic reporting workflows. Founded by Alex Lu and headquartered in London, PortF is backed by Techstars.

providers.name: Side
providers.description: Side is a technology-powered residential real estate brokerage platform that partners with top-producing agents, teams, and independent brokers to help them launch and grow their own branded brokerage companies without the time, cost, or risk of operating a traditional brokerage. Side provides back-office operations, compliance, transaction management, marketing, and a proprietary Side App that streamlines and automates real estate transactions. Founded in San Francisco, Side is backed by ICONIQ Capital, Matrix Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Trinity Ventures. Side runs a private, authenticated internal API (api.side.com/v1) that powers its app but publishes no public developer program, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: BetaPage
providers.description: BetaPage was a startup discovery and listing platform where founders, makers, and early adopters could discover and submit beta-stage and newly launched tech products. The platform served a community of 65,000+ startup founders and tech enthusiasts with 40,000+ tech products listed. BetaPage has since rebranded and redirects to PitchWall (pitchwall.co), an AI product discovery platform. No public developer API has been identified for BetaPage or its successor PitchWall.

providers.name: Finaccess
providers.description: Finaccess Mexico, S.A. de C.V., Sociedad Operadora de Fondos de Inversion, is an independent Mexican investment-fund operator (asset manager) authorized by the CNBV and the SHCP and regulated by Banco de Mexico. Founded in 2000 and headquartered in Mexico City, it is part of Grupo Finaccess and operates under the tagline "Acceso financiero para todos" (financial access for everyone). Finaccess manages the AXES family of mutual funds spanning short/medium/long-term local debt (AXES CP, MP, LP), domestic and international equity (AXES BMV, GLO, GSP, USA), dollar-denominated debt (AXES COB), and ESG equity (AXES ESG), and it distributes third-party funds from Franklin Templeton, Santander, and Scotiabank. It provides model portfolios, published rate-of-return tracking, and Morningstar-rated fund evaluation for retail and institutional clients. Finaccess publishes no public developer API; this profile carries company identity and domain-security enrichment only.

providers.name: Perennial Labs
providers.description: Perennial is an on-chain (EVM) perpetual-derivatives protocol — a composable, fully on-chain primitive for permissionless perpetual markets, liquidity provisioning (LPs up to 50x), vaults, collateral accounts, and intent-based order flow with off-chain solvers. Built by Equilibria and backed by Polychain, its developer surface is Solidity smart contracts (MultiInvoker batching) plus first-party TypeScript and Python SDKs and a subgraph, rather than a hosted REST API. The v2 protocol has been audited by Zellic and Sherlock and runs an Immunefi bug-bounty program (up to $500k). The hosted application (perennial.finance) has since been sunset, but the protocol contracts, documentation, and SDKs remain published.

providers.name: Century 21 Canada
providers.description: CENTURY 21 Canada Limited Partnership is the Canadian master franchisor of the CENTURY 21® real estate brand, headquartered at 1285 West Pender Street in Vancouver, British Columbia. The master licence for Canada was secured in Vancouver in 1976 — the first international franchise of the CENTURY 21 System — and the network today spans roughly 400 independently owned and operated offices from coast to coast. Century 21 Canada sits in the brokerage/franchisor layer of the Canadian real estate value chain: it does not originate listing data, it consumes it. Canadian residential listings are consolidated nationally by the Canadian Real Estate Association (CREA), which runs REALTOR.ca and the Data Distribution Facility (DDF®); franchisors and brokerages redistribute that member-owned MLS® content under CREA rules rather than publishing it themselves. Century 21 Canada's API posture is accordingly empty. As of a 2026-07-26 probe there is no developer portal, no API documentation, no published base URL, no SDK, no webhooks, no Postman collection and no machine-readable contract of any kind on century21.ca or c21.ca — both century21.ca and c21.ca resolve to the same WordPress consumer site whose terms of use name MoxiWorks LLC as the site operator, and whose property search is a hosted MoxiWorks Web Marketing System surface rather than a first-party API. Wildcard DNS on *.century21.ca and *.c21.ca returns HTTP 200 for every subdomain probed (developer., developers., api., docs.) by parking them all on eboat.moxiworks.com, so those 200s are a DNS artifact and not a developer portal. RESO is absent: no RESO Web API or Data Dictionary certification, no OData or $metadata endpoint, and no Universal Property Identifier reference appears anywhere in the public surface — consistent with Canada, where RESO certification is not the operative seam and CREA's DDF® is. The only genuinely public, anonymously callable machine-readable surface found is the incidental WordPress REST API route index at https://www.c21.ca/wp-json/, which is a CMS artifact, is undocumented by Century 21 Canada, and is deliberately not listed here as a product API. Agent- and franchisee-facing tools live behind the hub21.ca member login. This profile is therefore identity-only and honestly records a brokerage franchisor with no published developer surface.

providers.name: Exegy
providers.description: Exegy is a St. Louis-based provider of low-latency market data infrastructure, trading platforms, and predictive trading signals for capital markets, backed by Marlin Equity Partners after its 2021 merger with Vela Trading Systems and subsequent acquisitions of Enyx and NovaSparks. The firm sells managed FPGA ticker plants (Exegy Nexus), software feed handlers (SMDS, nxFeed), the Axiom normalized data feed, the Metro options trading platform, and market access products (nxAccess, FrontTrade, SREX). Client access to normalized real-time and historical market data is delivered through the proprietary Exegy Client API (XCAPI), a C++/C#/Java library for Linux and Windows, while Metro exposes the Subway socket API and Freeway algorithmic API - none of which are publicly documented HTTP APIs. All developer documentation sits behind customer logins (Exegy Customer Portal, Object Trading DMA portal, MarketDataPeaks), making this an entirely sales-gated, entitlement-managed offering with no self-serve API surface.

providers.name: Hundsun Technologies
providers.description: Hundsun Technologies Inc. is a leading Chinese fintech company providing software solutions and services for financial institutions including securities, funds, futures, banking, asset management, and wealth management. Hundsun's products are typically delivered as enterprise software with bespoke customer integrations rather than as a public developer API platform.

providers.name: Latitud
providers.description: Latitud is an early-stage venture capital firm and founder platform that writes first checks for Latin American founders, positioning itself as a bridge between the LatAm startup ecosystem and Silicon Valley. Its flagship program is the Latitud Fellowship, an eight-week remote program for pre-founders, dealmakers and technical builders that ends with a week-long roadshow in San Francisco, and which invests a $62,500 ideation check on a SAFE for a 2.5 percent stake in a cohort of eight fellows. Latitud also runs a portfolio support practice, a mentor network drawn from companies such as Mercado Libre, Vercel, Auth0 and Cornershop, and a Spanish- and Portuguese-language media surface including a podcast and community channels. Latitud publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs or machine-readable specifications; its public surface is a three-page marketing site (home, fellowship, portfolio) plus an application form, so this profile is an identity and web-properties record rather than an API profile.

providers.name: Pellego
providers.description: Pellego is a real estate technology and brokerage platform serving real estate professionals including agents, contractors, flippers, landlords, lenders, and wholesalers. It offers property analysis software (comparable sales analysis, rehab calculators, and investment filtering), a 100% commission brokerage for agents who hang their license, an agent marketplace connecting investors with experienced agents, and deal discovery for flips, rentals, and assumable loans. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. No public API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Savills
providers.description: Savills plc is a London-headquartered global real estate advisor, established in 1855, listed on the London Stock Exchange, with more than 42,000 people in over 70 countries.
