It sits on the advisory side of the property value chain rather than the data-platform side: commercial and prime residential agency, transaction advisory and capital markets, valuation and professional services, building and project consultancy, property and facilities management, rural and agricultural advisory, occupier services, the Savills Research publication programme, and a separate fund manager in Savills Investment Management. Its home market is the United Kingdom, where there is no MLS and no cooperative listing standard — residential stock reaches consumers through the Rightmove and Zoopla duopoly by way of agency CRM software (Reapit, Alto, Street, Apex27) rather than a shared cooperative pool. Savills is a supplier into that pipe, not an operator of it. Its API posture is the honest null case for this sector. Savills publishes no developer portal, no API documentation, no SDK, no Postman collection and no machine-readable contract of any kind: developer., developers., docs. and apis.savills.com do not resolve, /developers, /api, /docs, /openapi.json, /swagger.json and /api-docs on savills.com, savills.co.uk and savills.us all return 404, and no OpenID Connect discovery document is served. Undocumented internal service hosts do exist behind the consumer property search — livev6-searchapi, livev6-authentication and livev6-profile.savills.com, named in the search application's own endpoints.js — but every one of them returns 404 to an anonymous client and none is described anywhere public. There is no RESO Web API or Data Dictionary certification, no OData $metadata document and no Universal Property Identifier anywhere in the Savills estate; RESO is a North American NAR/MLS construct and the UK has nothing to certify against. Savills publishes no open data either — its research output is PDF and web narrative, and the genuinely open UK property layer belongs to the public sector (HM Land Registry Price Paid Data and Ordnance Survey), not to the brokerage. For a developer there is no gate to pass, because there is no door: the only published route is the corporate contact form.

providers.name: Stockbit
providers.description: Stockbit (PT Stockbit Sekuritas Digital) is an Indonesian retail-investing platform and social community for the Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX), letting members discuss, analyze, and trade stocks with real-time market data, fundamentals, trading ideas, news, and sentiment. The product is delivered as consumer iOS and Android apps plus a web experience, with a separate crypto brand (Stockbit Crypto). It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass Stockbit publishes no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI/Swagger definition, SDK, or .well-known discovery surface — the profile is maintained as a consumer-app company record rather than an API provider.

providers.name: Thndr
providers.description: Thndr is an Egyptian investment and brokerage mobile app that lets retail users open a regulated brokerage account and invest in Egyptian Exchange (EGX) stocks, US equities, mutual funds, ETFs, and IPOs from their phone. Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Cairo, Thndr is licensed by Egypt's Financial Regulatory Authority (FRA) and registered with the Egyptian Exchange as a brokerage, positioning itself as a low-cost, mobile-first gateway to the capital markets across Egypt and the wider MENA region. The company raised a $20M Series A in 2022 led by Tiger Global with participation from Prosus Ventures and others, and has been recognized among Forbes Middle East's top fintech companies. Thndr's product surface is a consumer investing app (iOS, Android, and a web account-access portal) with an educational Learn hub and a customer support center; as of this profile it publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API artifacts.

providers.name: CohnReznick
providers.description: CohnReznick is a top-25 US accounting, tax, and advisory firm formed in 2012 by the merger of J.H. Cohn LLP and Reznick Group, P.C. The firm serves clients across more than 30 industries from offices throughout the United States and four offshore subsidiaries, with its global reach extended through membership in the Nexia International network (operating in more than 128 countries). In May 2024 CohnReznick became the first US accounting firm of its scale to receive a strategic growth investment from a private equity sponsor when funds advised by Apax Partners acquired a majority stake. As part of that transaction the firm operates under an alternative-practice structure: audit and attest services are delivered by CohnReznick LLP (a licensed CPA firm) while tax and advisory services are delivered through CohnReznick Advisory LLC. Largest practice areas include Real Estate, Renewable Energy, Government Contracting, Asset Management (private equity, hedge funds, private credit, REITs), Financial Services, Healthcare, Life Sciences, Consumer & Industrial, Technology & Media, Public Sector, and Private Clients (family offices, high net worth individuals, professional sports). CohnReznick does not publish a public software developer API; this repository documents the firm's organizational profile, practice taxonomy, and linked-data context for API catalog purposes.

providers.name: Drahim Holdings
providers.description: Drahim (دراهم) is a Saudi personal-finance and automated-investment fintech, founded in Riyadh in 2021 by Sultan Alkhayal and Yasser Alshurihi. Its mobile app uses open banking to aggregate a user's bank accounts into one view, enriches and auto-categorizes transactions (2.5B+ processed), and offers auto-savings, Zakat calculation, and Sharia-compliant robo-advisory portfolios spanning 40+ funds across Saudi and global equities, real estate, and commodities. Drahim is licensed by the Saudi Central Bank (SAMA) for open-banking/payment services and by the Capital Market Authority (CMA) for investment management; it was backed by Y Combinator and 500 Global, and Al Rajhi Bank acquired a 65% majority stake in 2024. Drahim is a consumer application and does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal; this profile captures its corporate and product identity plus live domain-security posture. Consumer surfaces include the iOS and Android apps and a business platform.

providers.name: Warren
providers.description: Warren (Warren Investimentos e Gestao Patrimonial) is a Brazilian digital wealth-management and investment platform founded in 2017 and based in Porto Alegre. Regulated by Brazil's Central Bank, the CVM securities commission, and ANBIMA, Warren offers a goals-based, fee-only model spanning managed portfolios, ETFs, fixed income, global stocks, gold and crypto, private pension plans, life insurance, currency exchange, and business (PJ) accounts, plus a Warren for Business platform for investment professionals. It is backed by QED Investors, Ribbit Capital, and Citi Ventures. As of this enrichment pass Warren exposes no public developer API, documentation portal, or first-party SDK; its GitHub organization (warrenbrasil) contains internal engineering tooling and courseware rather than a consumer-facing API surface.

providers.name: Aerodyne
providers.description: Aerodyne Group is a Malaysia-headquartered DT3 (drone technology, data technology, and digital transformation) enterprise solutions provider, founded in 2014. Through its Drone-as-a-Service (DaaS) model and the AI-powered, cloud-based vertikaliti asset-management platform, Aerodyne turns aerial and sensor data into deep analytics and actionable insights for infrastructure, power line, wind turbine, solar, and agricultural (Agrimor) asset inspection and management. Operating across 45 countries with a global network of AeroRangers, it was ranked the world's number-one drone service provider by Drone Industry Insights in 2021 and 2022. Aerodyne is a 500 Global portfolio company. No public developer portal, API, or machine-readable specification has been identified at this time.

providers.name: Evreka
providers.description: Evreka is a smart waste and recycling management technology company offering an end-to-end "Sustainability as a Service" platform that digitizes the entire waste management lifecycle. Its software suite spans operations, fleet, asset, MRF, and workforce management, route optimization, citizen engagement, and EPR/PRO management, complemented by IoT hardware such as fill-level sensors, vehicle and container trackers, and RFID readers. Evreka serves dumpster rental, recycling centers, medical, hazardous and liquid waste, construction and demolition, local authorities, and cross-border waste operators. Backed by 500 Global, it is tracked in the API Evangelist network; no public API or developer portal is currently published.

providers.name: merama
providers.description: Merama is a Latin American e-commerce company that invests in and scales established online brands selling on marketplaces such as Amazon and MercadoLibre. It acquires a substantial stake while founders retain operational control, then provides working capital, business intelligence, digital marketing, cross-border expansion across Latin America and the US, and proprietary operating technology to accelerate growth. Merama operates as a brand aggregator / roll-up rather than a developer platform and publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK surface.

providers.name: Sovryn
providers.description: Sovryn is a Bitcoin-native, non-custodial decentralized finance (DeFi) protocol built on Rootstock (RSK). It offers spot and margin trading, perpetual swaps, 0% interest Bitcoin-backed loans (Zero), the Sovryn Dollar (DLLR) Bitcoin-backed stablecoin, yield and liquidity pools, and SOV governance staking, operating as a DAO. Sovryn also incubated BitcoinOS, a zk-powered rollup and multi-VM execution stack for Bitcoin. Developers integrate through open-source smart contracts, a GraphQL subgraph, an indexer HTTP data API, and first-party JavaScript SDKs published under the @sovryn and @sovryn-zero npm scopes.

providers.name: Spider Capital
providers.description: Spider Capital is a seed-stage venture capital firm investing in applied-AI enterprise cloud software that modernizes complex industrial sectors. The firm backs founders across construction, financial services, energy, government, healthcare, insurance, mining, manufacturing, supply chain, and transportation, citing 100+ enterprise cloud investments, a 70%+ seed-to-Series-A graduation rate, and portfolio companies including Mechanical Orchard, Imubit, CoLab, Percepto, Codoxo, Klir, Elara Spatial, and Logiwa. Surfaced as a portfolio company of foundry-group; it publishes no public API or developer surface (venture-capital firm), so this profile carries firm identity rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Scope
providers.description: Scope (Scope Inspection Ltd, London) is an AI-native inspection platform for the Testing, Inspection, and Certification (TIC) industry and heavy-asset operators. It captures field data through voice, video, and forms (offline-capable), extracts structured data from P&IDs, ASME forms, and inspection drawings, surfaces historical inspection context, and automates report generation in Word, Excel, and PDF. The product pushes results into enterprise CMMS/EAM systems via webhooks and prebuilt connectors, but publishes no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI, or documentation surface at this time. Backed by Index Ventures and Y Combinator; raised a ~$18-20M round led by Index Ventures in 2026.

providers.name: Aerodrome
providers.description: Aerodrome Finance is the central trading and liquidity marketplace on the Base network — a next-generation MetaDEX (automated market maker inspired by Solidly and Velodrome) that pairs a vote-escrow ve(3,3) tokenomics model with gauge-directed AERO emissions. It offers basic volatile (vAMM) and stable (sAMM) pools plus concentrated-liquidity Slipstream pools, letting liquidity providers, voters, and traders coordinate incentives on Base. Aerodrome is a smart-contract protocol rather than a hosted API: developers integrate through its onchain Solidity contracts, the shared open-source "Sugar" SDK (JavaScript and Python) that reads pool/veNFT/relay data and builds unsigned transactions, and GraphQL subgraphs for analytics. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from public sources.

providers.name: Close Brothers
providers.description: Close Brothers Group plc (LSE: CBG) is a UK merchant banking group founded in 1878 and a constituent of the FTSE 250 Index, headquartered at 10 Crown Place, London EC2A 4FT. The group provides specialist lending across motor, premium, asset, invoice, and property finance; takes personal and business deposits through Close Brothers Savings; manages wealth through Close Brothers Asset Management; and trades securities through Winterflood. Its banking entity, Close Brothers Limited, is authorised by the Prudential Regulation Authority and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority and the PRA. Close Brothers is not one of the CMA9 mandated banks; it offers savings and deposit products rather than online payment (current) accounts, and therefore carries no UK Open Banking (OBIE / PSD2) Read/Write or Open Data publishing obligation. As of this profile no public developer portal, Open Banking Open Data endpoint, or documented API surface could be confirmed for the group.

providers.name: Goin
providers.description: Goin is a European consumer fintech platform, backed by Anthemis and based in Barcelona, Spain, that helps more than 700,000 users across Europe grow their money and spend less. The app bundles automated savings (fixed daily, weekly or monthly rules and goal-based portfolios), investing, buying and selling of cryptocurrencies, cashback and rewards at hundreds of online and physical stores, gift cards and coupons, and a browser extension that surfaces discounts while shopping. Bank accounts are connected securely under Europe's PSD2 open banking regulation, and a referral program rewards users for inviting friends. Goin is a business-to-consumer mobile product distributed through the Apple App Store and Google Play; it does not publish a public developer program, API, or documentation surface. This API Evangelist profile tracks Goin as a portfolio lead and captures its public web, help, and legal presence.

providers.name: Republic
providers.description: Republic is a New York-based fintech and private investing platform (republic.com) that lets retail and accredited investors access early-stage startups, private companies, real estate, crypto, and other alternative assets through regulated investment crowdfunding offerings. Backed by prosus-ventures, Republic operates a consumer investing marketplace rather than a public developer platform: it publishes a security and compliance posture (SOC 2, ISO 27001) at republic.com/security but exposes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or documentation surface at the time of this enrichment pass. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio-company lead and enriched with the provider-security signals that could be probed directly.

providers.name: Edgefolio
providers.description: Edgefolio is a London-based financial technology company providing a digital capital-raising and fund-marketing platform for the hedge fund industry. Its SaaS products connect hedge funds, prime brokers, and institutional investors: Edgefolio for Managers offers a secure data-room and CRM for fund managers to control their data, manage investor relationships, and collaborate; Edgefolio for Prime Brokers delivers capital introduction and consulting tooling for cap intro teams; and Edgefolio for Investors is a fund screening and research platform with integrated market data. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Seedcamp. As of this enrichment pass Edgefolio publishes no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI specification, or SDKs — the platform is delivered as a private B2B application accessed via demo and client login.

providers.name: Evercore Inc
providers.description: Evercore Inc is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Evercore Inc API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Trucks Venture Fund I
providers.description: Trucks Venture Capital (Trucks VC) is an early-stage venture firm headquartered in San Francisco investing in companies building the future of transportation — making mobility decarbonized, safer, and more accessible. Its focus spans autonomous vehicles, electric aviation, agricultural robotics, fleet management, and mobility infrastructure. Trucks Venture Fund I is the firm's first fund; notable portfolio outcomes include Joby Aviation (NYSE: JOBY), Bear Flag Robotics (acquired by John Deere), nuTonomy (acquired by Delphi), Roadster (acquired by CDK Global), and Zendrive (acquired by Intuit). Surfaced as a portfolio relation of 500 Global and profiled in the API Evangelist network as a venture-capital firm; it publishes a marketing/portfolio website but no developer API surface.

providers.name: Westbound Equity Partners
providers.description: Westbound Equity Partners is a venture capital firm that invests financial and social capital into values-aligned founding teams, aiming to build a virtuous cycle of wealth and opportunity. The firm backs ventures across workplace equity and wealth-building, climate tech and decarbonization, AI and advanced technology, and social impact, and supports founders through the Westbound Network of entrepreneurs, operators, and investors plus culture coaching and talent services. Portfolio companies include Esusu, Planet FWD, Syndio, Sierra, Mon Ami, The Browser Company, Conduit Tech, Manas AI, and Laborup. Surfaced as a portfolio company of foundry-group. Westbound publishes a marketing and careers website but no public developer or API program.

providers.name: Axiom Trust
providers.description: Axiom Trust Company is a vertically integrated trust company and technology platform serving investment advisors, attorneys, trustees, and private families. Founded in 2025 by David Meister and headquartered in Las Vegas, Nevada, Axiom pairs a regulated corporate trustee with a proprietary data-driven administration platform, using technology to remove the administrative bottleneck of traditional trust administration so named trust officers can focus on fiduciary judgment and family relationships. The company positions itself as infrastructure rather than a competitor for the client relationship: it acts as independent or directed trustee, handles bill pay, notices, distributions, approvals and principal & income accounting, and takes on complex mandates other institutions avoid — closely held entities, private investments, contested situations, and special needs trusts. Axiom raised $11.8M in pre-seed and seed funding led by Lightspeed Venture Partners, with Wischoff Ventures, Runa Capital, SNR, Primetime Partners, and Mercury founder Immad Akhund participating. As of this profile Axiom Trust publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API artifacts; its client-facing application is a private authenticated web app.

providers.name: Jefferies Financial Group
providers.description: Jefferies Financial Group is a leading global, full-service investment banking and capital markets firm providing advisory, capital raising, sales, trading, research, wealth management, and alternative asset management services to clients across the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, and the Asia-Pacific.

providers.name: LTSE
providers.description: The Long-Term Stock Exchange (LTSE) is a U.S. national securities exchange, approved by the SEC, built to help companies and investors focus on long-term value creation over short-term results. LTSE operates a stock exchange and trading platform with listing standards organized around five long-term principles covering stakeholders, strategy, executive compensation, board governance, and investor engagement. The company also publishes market and governance insights and produces The Eric Ries Show podcast. LTSE previously offered a cap-table management product (LTSE Equity, formerly Captable.io) which has since been sunset and transitioned to Astrella. LTSE exposes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its public web and security posture.

providers.name: Net Worth
providers.description: netWorth (networth.mx) is a Mexico City fintech founded in 2016 and a 500 Startups (500 Global) Batch 10 company that helps individuals plan and manage retirement in Mexico. It specializes in Planes Personales de Retiro (PPR) and long-term savings and investment plans, combining human financial advisors (asesores) with digital tools such as retirement calculators and simulators, and commercializes plans backed by insurers and financial institutions such as Allianz and Skandia (Optimaxx Plus). The consumer product surfaces are a Webflow marketing site plus a client app at retiro.networth.mx and an authenticated portal at api.networth.mx; there is no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or SDK program at this time.

providers.name: Vector Legal
providers.description: Vector Legal is an AI-native law firm and legal operating system for startups, combining senior startup attorneys (averaging 10+ years of Big Law experience) with proprietary software for formation, fundraising, commercial contracts, employment and equity, and M&A, priced around outcomes rather than billable hours. Legal services are provided by Vector Legal, P.C., a licensed California law firm; the platform is built by Vector Systems, PBC. A Y Combinator Winter 2026 company headquartered in San Francisco, also backed by Base10, Palm Drive Capital, and Amino Capital.

providers.name: Voya Financial
providers.description: Voya Financial (NYSE: VOYA) is a leading health, wealth, and investment company serving approximately 14.7 million individual, workplace, and institutional clients. Voya specializes in retirement plans, group employee benefits, health savings accounts (HSAs), and investment management. Their myVoyage platform integrates financial wellness tools to help participants plan, invest, and protect their financial futures. Voya does not offer a public developer API but provides account connectivity through open banking aggregators such as Plaid.

providers.name: Sahi
providers.description: Sahi is a high-performance Indian stock trading platform built for active retail traders, operated by Aaritya Broking Private Limited (SEBI INZ000317632) and based in Bangalore. Founded by Dale Vaz (former Swiggy CTO) and Manish Jain (former Kotak Securities executive), Sahi offers futures & options trading, equity/stock trading, IPO applications, and ETF investing at a flat brokerage of Rs.10 per executed order. The mobile-native platform emphasizes millisecond order-execution latency, an in-house charting tool (Sahi Charts), real-time stock scanners, AI-backed market intelligence, and SEBI-registered research. Sahi is an Accel portfolio company. It does not currently publish a public developer API, but it does publish a machine-readable /llms.txt.

providers.name: Seed Club
providers.description: Seed Club is a web3 accelerator and community focused on consumer crypto, helping founders build "a dramatically more interesting internet" where the value created by online communities is captured by people rather than platforms. It runs a cohort-based accelerator (currently SC07: Consumer Crypto), a ventures/investment arm, and a portfolio program, alongside a broader community of builders, creators, and token communities. Seed Club operates as a community-owned organization and publishes a public Community Handbook, a blog, and open-source dApp code (Farcaster frames, crowdfunding smart contracts). It is a portfolio company of Kindred Ventures. Seed Club is a program and community brand rather than an API provider — it exposes no public developer platform, REST/GraphQL API, SDKs, or machine-readable discovery surface at this time.

providers.name: Vosbor
providers.description: Vosbor is a digital trading platform for bulk agricultural commodities, headquartered in Amsterdam with offices in Singapore and Shanghai. Founded in 2019 and backed by Lux Capital, its exchange lets trading firms and end users trade corn, wheat, soybean, palm oil and other grains and oilseeds in spot and forward markets, with integrated KYC, encrypted trade data, straight-through processing, and a WhatsApp AI broker that negotiates with multiple counterparties simultaneously. Market data is downloadable in CSV, and the company advertises data access through an API for customers, but publishes no public developer portal or API documentation.

providers.name: Cabal
providers.description: Cabal is an AI-powered relationship-intelligence and warm-introduction platform that turns an organization's professional relationships into warm introductions. It infers connections across millions of professional records without CSV uploads or calendar syncs, letting teams "ask who's connected to anyone." Cabal serves VC platform / deal-sourcing teams, sales organizations, and investor-relations and partnerships teams, and ships Cabal Mail for bulk personalized outreach (company updates, LP communications, strategic asks). The relationship graph is queryable through in-app chat, Claude and ChatGPT via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), a Slack bot, or an API. Backed by Craft Ventures. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from Cabal's public surface; the company advertises API and MCP access but does not publish a public OpenAPI spec or open developer reference (both are account-gated).

providers.name: Diametric Capital
providers.description: Diametric Capital is an equity long/short, multi-manager investment fund firm headquartered in Boston and New York. The firm builds customizable funds that isolate what it calls "True Alpha" — returns uncorrelated to the broader market — by removing beta and factor risk exposure to deliver performance with below-average volatility. Alongside its funds it offers aligned fee structures, capital partnerships, and business development support to entrepreneurs and emerging managers. Diametric Capital is a private financial firm and does not publish a public developer program, API, or SDK surface; it operates a secure client data room for investors and partners.

providers.name: High Alpha Capital
providers.description: High Alpha is an Indianapolis-based venture firm that creates and funds B2B SaaS and enterprise software companies, partnering with founders through both a venture studio that co-creates companies from scratch and a capital arm that invests in early-stage enterprise software startups. Its focus spans healthcare, sales enablement, supply chain, agtech, and other B2B verticals, and its portfolio and alumni include companies such as Salesloft, Attentive, Lessonly, Stitch, Tenon, and Liminal. High Alpha also publishes the widely referenced SaaS Benchmarks Report. This profile tracks the firm in the API Evangelist network; as a venture firm it has no public developer or API surface of its own.

providers.name: KKR
providers.description: KKR & Co. Inc. is a leading global investment firm offering solutions in alternative assets spanning real estate, private credit, private equity, and infrastructure, as well as liquid credit, capital markets and insurance. KKR does not currently publish a public developer portal or open API program; this repository tracks the company in the API Evangelist Network for context, common properties, and future developer resource discovery.

providers.name: Lowercarbon Capital
providers.description: Lowercarbon Capital is a climate-focused venture capital firm that backs companies making real money by slashing CO2 emissions, removing carbon from the atmosphere, and buying the planet more time. The firm invests across energy, transportation, materials, agriculture, carbon removal, and planetary-cooling technologies, on the thesis that markets — not shame or guilt — will fix the climate. It was surfaced as a portfolio-linked company and added to the API Evangelist network. Lowercarbon Capital publishes no public API or developer program; this profile captures the firm's identity and web properties.

providers.name: Palus Finance
providers.description: Palus Finance is a Y Combinator (Winter 2026) financial-advisory startup that acts as a startup's outsourced financial advisor and Registered Investment Advisor (RIA) with a fiduciary duty to its clients. Palus automatically manages a company's reserve cash and treasury, sweeping idle balances into NVCA-compliant bond portfolios built from U.S. government securities and T-Bills to optimize yield (targeting roughly a SOFR + 1% spread) while preserving safety and liquidity. It connects to a company's existing bank accounts (via Plaid) rather than requiring an account switch, sizes allocations against runway and burn rate, and can be set up in under ten minutes with no minimums or lockups. Palus is a managed, human-plus-software advisory product delivered through its web application; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Resolute Ventures
providers.description: Resolute Ventures is an early-stage venture capital firm that typically writes a founder's first VC check, backing pre-seed and seed-stage companies. Co-founded by Mike Hirshland and Raanan Bar-Cohen, the firm invests in people rather than ideas, backing mission-driven founders with the grit, energy and conviction to bring their ideas to life and offering community, mentorship, health & wellness, and team-building support. Portfolio companies include Vercel, Opendoor, Greenhouse, Hello Heart and Signifyd. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Foundry Group.

providers.name: Savahq
providers.description: Sava (Savahq) is an early-stage Y Combinator company building what it calls the intelligence layer for enduring legacies and the future of trusts, operating at the intersection of financial and legal technology for trust administration and estate management. As of this profile the public presence is a pre-product landing page at savahq.com that collects email signups, and the company publishes no developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or other machine-readable API surface. This record tracks Sava within the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead surfaced from the Y Combinator portfolio, to be re-enriched once a developer or API surface is published.

providers.name: Stem AI
providers.description: StemAI (Stem AI SAS) is a Paris-based accelerator and early-stage investment program for founders building LLM-powered products. Its stated thesis is that large language models are already capable enough to build great products today, so the program backs product and user experience rather than research breakthroughs. Each accepted company receives a $250,000 SAFE investment, $350,000 in partner cloud credits, recurring checkpoints with AI advisors, help accessing follow-on funding, and a founder summit hosted in Paris. The program is led by Nicolas Granatino, with a board that includes Mehdi Ghissassi (AI71) and Severine Gregoire (Zebox Ventures), and advisors in residence drawn from Hugging Face, Datadog, InstaDeep, Dust, Photoroom, Helsing, Nabla, QuantHouse and Parrot. StemAI is a private company whose shares are quoted on the secondary markets (Forge, Hiive, EquityZen). It publishes no API, SDK, developer portal or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: Titan Invest
providers.description: Titan (titan.com), operating the brand Titan Invest, is a wealth management firm founded in 2017 and headquartered in New York City that serves high-performing technology professionals. Titan combines AI-assisted technology with dedicated human wealth teams to deliver actively managed portfolios, direct indexing and equity-diversification strategies, tax planning, and financial advisory for pre- and post-IPO tech employees, charging a 0.4% annual advisory fee. The company reports managing roughly $1.2B in assets for more than 10,000 clients and is backed by General Catalyst. Titan delivers its service through consumer web and mobile applications and advisor relationships; it does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a developer portal, so this profile captures the company identity and domain-security posture rather than an API surface.

providers.name: Exotic Markets
providers.description: Exotic Markets is a decentralized options and structured-products protocol on the Solana blockchain, describing itself as the #1 options protocol on Solana and backed by Multicoin Capital. The platform lets users earn yield or buy call/put options through flexible structured products, including baskets of tokens, accumulators, and capital-preservation strategies with customizable payoffs and maturities. Access is on-chain via a Solana wallet (Phantom, Solflare) and the $EXO token powers staking, points, and protocol utility. Exotic Markets is a smart-contract DeFi protocol rather than a REST/HTTP API provider: there is no public OpenAPI, gateway, or hosted developer API surface; developer materials are limited to GitBook documentation, a GitHub organization, and community channels.

providers.name: The Human Utility
providers.description: The Human Utility (formerly the Detroit Water Project) is a Y Combinator-backed not-for-profit organization founded in 2014 by Tiffani Ashley Bell whose mission is to preserve human dignity by increasing water affordability for families across the United States. It matches families who are behind on their water bills with donors who want to help, paying utility companies directly on their behalf through crowdfunded donations, community-building, and policy action. Operating in Detroit, Baltimore, and dozens of other cities, it has helped thousands of households avoid water shutoffs. The Human Utility runs a public-facing web application for donors and recipients rather than a developer-facing API product; its source code lives in the humanutility GitHub organization. This profile was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company and enriched with identity and link details; no public API surface was found.

providers.name: A Capital
providers.description: A.Capital Ventures is an early-stage venture capital firm founded by Ronny Conway, a former partner at Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and one of the first employees at Google Ventures. The firm provides funding, talent, and strategic counsel to founders building at the frontier of technology, with a portfolio spanning AI and machine learning (OpenAI, Anthropic, Hugging Face, Character.ai), developer tools (Notion, Replit, Databricks), and crypto and consumer platforms (Coinbase, Uniswap, Reddit, Airbnb). A.Capital differs from standard venture models by customizing investment amounts rather than enforcing ownership thresholds, advising without mandatory board seats, and staffing full-time Talent Partners to help early-stage teams hire and build their organizational foundation. This profile was surfaced via the a16z network (through founder Ronny Conway's a16z tenure) and enriched from the firm's public website. A.Capital is a venture capital firm and does not publish a developer-facing API surface, developer portal, or API artifacts.

providers.name: AlgoX2
providers.description: AlgoX2 is a data streaming operating system that unifies ingestion, ordering, fan-out, transformation, and durable storage into a single fault-tolerant engine, positioned as an alternative to assembling Kafka, Flink, and Redis. Built by veterans of NYSE Pillar's matching engine, the platform offers a partition-free API, compute-storage separation, a zero-copy runtime, and native multicast fan-out, with native support for Kafka, NATS, MQTT, Redis, HTTP, and WebSocket protocols and protocol bridging between them. Streams automatically materialize as Apache Iceberg, Delta, or Hudi tables in S3-compatible Parquet storage for lakehouse integration. AlgoX2 raised a $3.5M seed round led by Bessemer Venture Partners and serves real-time use cases including exchange and matching-engine infrastructure, market-data distribution, risk and surveillance, backtesting, and AI feature streaming.

providers.name: AXA
providers.description: AXA is a French multinational insurance firm and one of the world's largest providers of life, health, property & casualty, and asset management services. AXA does not publish a single global developer portal; technology integration is delivered through country-specific broker and partner portals, AXA Partners B2B2C distribution channels, AXA XL specialty insurance APIs for commercial brokers, and ACORD / EDI standards used across the insurance industry.

providers.name: Donkey
providers.description: Donkey is an AI-native trading company (Y Combinator, Summer 2026) that buys directly from Chinese factories and sells delivered duty-paid to US importers. Donkey mines public US customs records to identify the factory that actually makes a product, returns a landed DDP quote within 72 hours, runs its own on-the-floor quality inspections before the factory is paid, clears customs, moves the money, and offers credit-insured net-45 terms to qualified buyers. Founded by Benjamin Martindale (CEO) and Minghao Tan (CTO), the company runs small teams in San Francisco and China. Donkey publishes no public API, SDK, or developer platform today; this profile tracks its company identity in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: HODL Media
providers.description: HODL Media (hodl.mobi) is the maker of HODL Real-Time Cryptocurrency, a consumer mobile application for iOS and Android that tracks cryptocurrency and stock market prices in real time. The app aggregates pricing from 180+ global exchanges, offers customizable charting with technical indicators, price alerts and bracket management, portfolio tracking with exchange and wallet synchronization (Coinbase Pro, Binance, Ethereum wallets), aggregated news and social feeds, and stock market data from NYSE and NASDAQ. It is a portfolio company of 500 Global. As of this profile HODL Media publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal, or programmatic documentation; this repo is maintained as an API Evangelist network lead.

providers.name: Irreverent Labs
providers.description: Irreverent Labs is a Bellevue, Washington startup founded in 2021 and backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Samsung Next, and Michael Ovitz. The company began by building MechaFightClub, a web3 gaming property, then pivoted to generative AI, developing video foundation models intended to let creators, game studios, and developers produce short-form video from natural-language prompts. Its current public product is Supermodel (supermodel.ai), an autonomous on-chain trading agent that watches top Hyperliquid wallets, scores their track records, and fuses crowd, technical, and prediction-market signals into trades. The company has publicly signaled intent to ship a developer API for its video generation models, but no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI, or SDK has been released as of this profile.

providers.name: Pocket Protector
providers.description: Pocket Protector is a consumer peer-to-peer trading application operated by Pocket Protector Inc. Under the tagline "Trade Better Together," it lets users trade items and assets with one another through an iOS app and an accompanying Telegram bot (@pocketprotectorbot). The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Electric Capital and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; as of this pass it publishes a marketing site with privacy and terms pages but no public developer API, SDK, documentation, or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: Rally Rd
providers.description: Rally (formerly Rally Rd.) is a New York-based alternative-asset investment platform that lets everyday investors buy and sell equity shares in collectible assets — classic cars, watches, art, wine, sports memorabilia, natural-history artifacts, musical instruments and first-edition books. Rally sources and authenticates each item, registers it with the SEC as a security through FINRA/SIPC registered broker-dealer partners, splits it into equity shares, and opens an Initial Offering in its iOS, Android and web app where investors of all sizes can buy in from as little as $50 and later trade via in-app Bid/Ask. Rally was surfaced as a portfolio company of Anthemis. It publishes no public developer API or developer portal; this profile captures its verified public identity and web properties.

providers.name: RealPact
providers.description: RealPact is a Y Combinator (Summer 2026) startup building an AI-native operating system for real estate brokerages. Its voice-enabled AI agents automate the operational work behind every deal: the Deed Agent retrieves county deed records and flags encumbrances, the Tax & Vision Agent uses computer vision to extract tax assessments and property details, the Property Agent consolidates ownership and property information, and the Transaction Agent auto-fills contracts, manages disclosures, coordinates signatures, and tracks compliance deadlines. The company aims to compress transaction workflows from hours to minutes for brokerages, with early customers including Four Seasons Sotheby's International Realty and Black House Real Estate. Backed by Y Combinator and the LeapYear Fund, RealPact currently operates a customer-facing application and marketing site but publishes no public API, SDK, or developer program as of this profiling.

providers.name: Chipper Cash
providers.description: Chipper Cash is a pan-African fintech (legal entities Critical Ideas, Inc. and Voyse Technologies US, Inc.) operating a mobile-first cross-border money transfer, digital payments, crypto, and investing platform across Africa and the diaspora. Founded in 2018 by Ham Serunjogi (Uganda) and Maijid Moujaled (Ghana) after they met at Grinnell College in Iowa, Chipper became one of Africa's fintech unicorns in 2021 and has raised over $340M to date. The consumer app — available on iOS, Android, and web — supports peer-to-peer and cross-border transfers across 21+ African countries, virtual Visa cards (Chipper Card), bill pay and airtime top-ups, fractional US-stock investing (Chipper Stocks, 6,000+ public companies, from $1), and historically crypto trading (BTC/ETH). Reported scale includes 5M+ registered users, 1M+ Visa cards issued, and 250,000+ daily transactions. Direct consumer markets include Nigeria, Ghana, Uganda, Tanzania, South Africa, Rwanda, the UK, and the US. On the developer side, Chipper exposes the Chipper Network API ("Pay With Chipper") — a merchant-facing API that lets authorized businesses accept cross-border payments across 9 currencies, initiate payouts, issue refunds, and look up Chipper user accounts, authenticated with a Chipper User ID + Network API Key. Documentation is published as a Postman collection and access is gated by merchant onboarding; no public OpenAPI or open-source SDK is currently published. Adjacent products include Chipper ID (AI-led identity verification), Chipper Enterprise (bulk payments and collections), Business Accounts, and Zoona (agent-network remittances), plus an integration with TBD's tbDEX protocol for decentralized cross-border payments.

providers.name: Smart Crowd
providers.description: SmartCrowd is MENA's first and biggest regulated real estate crowdfunding and investment platform, based in Dubai and licensed by the Dubai Financial Services Authority (DFSA). It lets retail investors pool capital to co-own income-generating Dubai properties from as little as AED 500, offering both long-term Hold properties (rental yield) and short-term Flip properties (renovation upside), plus a secondary Share Transfer Facility for liquidity. SmartCrowd operates a consumer web and mobile app experience with no public developer API surface documented at this time.

providers.name: Createra
providers.description: Createra is a user-generated-content (UGC) gaming metaverse platform backed by Andreessen Horowitz, built by the Code Infinity team associated with the youth-coding company Codemao. The platform lets creators build and publish infinitely engaging 3D worlds and games directly in the browser, founded on the belief that creativity is a talent that everyone possesses. Its Box3 creation platform published a first-party JavaScript web SDK to npm as @box3/web-sdk. As of a July 2026 probe the createra.fun website returns no response over HTTP or HTTPS, no developer portal, documentation, API reference, OpenAPI definition, or /.well-known discovery surface could be located, and the npm SDK has not been republished since January 2023 — this profile therefore records Createra as a dormant company with no active public API surface.

providers.name: Iress
providers.description: Iress is a technology company providing software for financial markets, wealth management, and trading. Iress QuantFeed is a signature end-to-end ultra-low latency market data API that connects over 240 normalized market data feeds from 80+ sources.

providers.name: Willow Wealth
providers.description: Willow Wealth Inc. - formerly Yieldstreet - is a New York City financial technology company that operates an online private-markets investing platform, giving accredited and retail investors access to alternative asset classes including real estate, private credit, private equity, art, legal finance, and third-party evergreen funds from institutional managers. Founded in 2015 by Milind Mehere and Michael Weisz, the platform reports more than 500,000 members and over $6 billion in cumulative investments, and renamed itself Willow Wealth in late 2025. Investors reach it through a web portal and iOS/Android apps; the company publishes no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: A-Frame
providers.description: A-Frame Brands is a Los Angeles-based consumer brand incubator and product-development company founded in 2019 by entrepreneur Ari Bloom and actor Hill Harper. It partners with celebrities and cultural figures to build purpose-driven personal-care, beauty, fragrance, home-care, and pet-care brands, taking each from opportunity identification through product development, design, sourcing, production, and retail go-to-market. Brands in its portfolio include LOVED01 (John Legend), Kinlo (Naomi Osaka), Proudly (Gabrielle Union and Dwyane Wade), and Purrfect Paws, sold through retailers such as Target, Walmart, Amazon, CVS, JCPenney, QVC, and Bath & Body Works. Backed by Initialized Capital. This is a consumer company profile in the API Evangelist network; A-Frame publishes no public API or developer program.

providers.name: Arca
providers.description: Arca (Arca Financial, Inc.) is an AI-native wealth management company founded by former Plaid product leader Rron Rexha and headquartered in New York. It pairs human financial advisors with a fully integrated, agentic platform in which AI agents are the primary operational users: monitoring emails, calls, documents, market data, and news, coordinating with one another, generating dynamic user interfaces, and executing multi-step advisory workflows so advisors can focus on client relationships. Arca is an SEC-registered investment adviser managing over $1 billion in client assets, and raised $64M across a seed round (led by Venrock) and a Series A (led by General Catalyst, with Index Ventures and Venrock). It has no public developer API surface at this time; this profile captures its public identity and security posture.

providers.name: ElMetr
providers.description: ElMetr (المتر) is a Middle East legal-tech company providing online legal consultation and guidance for companies, entrepreneurs, and individuals. The platform combines licensed lawyers with modern technology to connect users with qualified legal help, offering subscription legal packages that cover company formation and registration, contract review, compliance, intellectual property, and dispute resolution. Founded in Egypt and now operating in Saudi Arabia, ElMetr aims to make legal work clear, fast, and fair so businesses can move faster and reduce risk from first idea through expansion. ElMetr is a 500 Global (500 Startups) portfolio company. This company profile has been through the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline; ElMetr does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: Fractal
providers.description: Fractal Software (fractalsoftware.com) is a venture studio that partners with entrepreneurs and investors to launch AI-driven vertical SaaS companies that transform how whole industries operate. Rather than shipping a single product, Fractal functions as an incubator and holding company, standing up sector-specific software startups across produce, healthcare, government, storage, distribution, and security-services verticals, with more than $650M raised across its portfolio. As a venture studio it exposes no public developer platform, API, SDKs, or documentation of its own; this profile captures its identity, portfolio surface, and domain-security posture. Note the recorded x-backed-by (multicoin, paradigm, a16z, 8vc) was surfaced via name-matching during portfolio ingestion and may conflate a distinct crypto-era "Fractal"; the enriched identity below reflects the fractalsoftware.com venture studio.

providers.name: Intellilake
providers.description: Intellilake is an early-stage company backed by Anthemis and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead. Its public presence at intellilake.com is currently a placeholder landing page with a corporate contact address and a published privacy policy; the site references online services that require user accounts and login, affiliates, and third-party service providers, but as of this enrichment pass it publishes no developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI, SDKs, or other machine-readable API surface. This profile remains a lead awaiting a public API before deeper enrichment.

providers.name: Meta4 Capital
providers.description: Meta4 Capital is a crypto-focused investment firm ("Quintessentially Crypto") founded in 2021 that invests in programmable and digital assets. Anchored by a lead investment from a16z crypto, the firm runs several strategies including an NFT fund, NFT-backed lending, an AI/decentralized-intelligence fund (Bittensor / $TAO), and early-stage crypto ventures. It is an asset manager and investment vehicle, not an API producer, so it exposes no developer, API, or SDK surface.

providers.name: Rocket Internet
providers.description: Rocket Internet SE is a Berlin-based internet company builder and technology investment firm founded by the Samwer brothers. It incubates and scales internet and technology ventures globally and invests through its venture arm, having built and backed more than 200 companies across six continents in e-commerce, marketplaces, fintech, food delivery, and consumer internet. Rocket Internet operates as a holding and operational-support platform rather than a product or API provider, so it exposes no public developer API, SDKs, or documentation surface. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of HV Capital and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Scoutzie
providers.description: Scoutzie is a Y Combinator-founded company (2012) led by Kirill Zubovsky. It launched as a curated marketplace connecting startups with top mobile designers and developers, operating from 2012 to 2020, and has since transformed into an AI-powered MVP (minimum viable product) development agency that builds and ships startup products in roughly two weeks. Today Scoutzie sells product-development services, an MVP Agent, founder training, and SEO consulting rather than a public developer API. It was surfaced through the a16z portfolio graph and enriched here as an API Evangelist network company profile.

providers.name: The Coterie
providers.description: The Coterie is a financial technology company founded in 2022 by Ethan Agarwal, Jeson Patel, and Chris Boies to give startup founders access to venture capital investments, estate-planning strategies (including its ATOM Trust product), and lending. Backed by Andreessen Horowitz, the company has since rebranded and now operates as Allocate (allocate.co), positioning itself as "an operating system for private markets" serving wealth advisors and asset managers with deal sourcing, white-labeled fund creation, AI-powered portfolio management, and unified reporting. The company publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs; this profile captures its identity and public web surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Vaas
providers.description: Vaas is a Colombian fintech building debt infrastructure for Latin America, operating a platform that automates asset-backed debt facilities for originators, asset managers, and debt providers across industries. Vaas autonomously verifies asset documentation, reconciles cash flows end to end, and enforces collateral ownership in real time so assets cannot be pledged twice, bringing liquidity and transparency to private credit. Backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z). Vaas does not currently publish a public API or developer portal.

providers.name: Yipitdata
providers.description: YipitData is a market-intelligence and alternative-data company that delivers daily insights on consumer behavior, market share, pricing, and company performance to the world's largest hedge funds, investors, brands, and retailers. Its Proprietary Data Network combines owned-and-operated B2C and B2B panels with 40+ always-on sources (consumer receipts, card transactions, B2B and cloud spend, web-scraped signals), analyzed on a Databricks/Delta Lake lakehouse and delivered through data-sharing, hosted apps, and its AI-powered Insight Agent rather than a public developer API.

providers.name: Crunched
providers.description: Crunched is an AI Excel analyst for power users in management consulting, investment banking, private equity, and corporate finance. Working as a native Microsoft Excel add-in (Mac and PC) and a companion PowerPoint deck reviewer, it builds fully linked financial models (DCFs, LBOs, cohort and scenario analyses) from plain-English instructions, error-checks entire workbooks, extracts and structures data from PDFs and web sources, formats spreadsheets, and generates client-ready slides with full workbook context. Every edit is tracked with a full audit trail and cited sources. Founded by Philip Borge and Michael Sakowski (ex-McKinsey private equity), Crunched is ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II certified and GDPR compliant, and is backed by Y Combinator, First Round Capital, and 20VC. It is distributed through the Microsoft AppSource marketplace and does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Apollo Global Management
providers.description: Apollo Global Management is a global alternative investment manager providing private equity, credit, and real assets strategies to institutional and individual investors. With over $840 billion in assets under management, Apollo focuses on delivering excess returns through its private equity, credit, and real assets business segments. Apollo does not have a public developer API program.

providers.name: Chingona Ventures
providers.description: Chingona Ventures is an early-stage venture capital firm that writes first institutional checks into pre-seed companies, typically investing $250,000 to $2 million into founders building in industries that are massively changing. The firm concentrates on financial technology, the future of work, the future of learning, and health technology, backing founders with unique market positioning in large, often overlooked growth markets. Its portfolio spans 40+ companies including Finix, Hologram, Suma Wealth, Honey Homes, Connect Care Hero, and Boom Pay. This API Evangelist profile was originally surfaced as a venture-capital lead and has been enriched with firm identity and domain-security signals; the firm publishes no public API, so API-specific artifacts are not applicable.

providers.name: Midas
providers.description: Midas is an onchain asset-management protocol that brings institutional-grade investment strategies onchain as tokenized real-world assets (RWAs). It issues permissionless, fully-backed tokenized products — including tokenized US Treasury bills (mTBILL), yield and basis strategies (mBASIS) and other onchain investment products — that offer full transparency, instant liquidity and native composability across DeFi. Investors mint and redeem Midas tokens directly against the underlying assets, and the resulting ERC-20 tokens can be used as collateral and as building blocks throughout the onchain economy. Positioned as "the standard for onchain investment products," Midas surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a fintech portfolio company for enrichment.

providers.name: Jar
providers.description: Jar is a Bengaluru-based fintech company operating India's first micro-savings app, enabling tens of millions of Indians to save in 24K digital gold from as little as ₹10. The app supports daily, weekly, monthly, and instant savings mechanisms, plus a round-up feature that automatically invests spare change from everyday transactions into 99.5%+ pure digital gold held in insured vaults. Founded in 2021 by Nishchay AG (CEO) and Misbah Ashraf (CPO) under Changejar Technologies Private Limited, Jar has grown to 50+ million registered users across 12,000+ Indian zip codes. The company recently vertically integrated its gold operations, moving away from a third-party distribution model to purchase, store, and manage gold directly. Jar partners with Brink's for global custody, ICICI Lombard for insurance, Vistra as independent trustee, and BDO as statutory auditor. Adjacent products include Nek, a direct-to-consumer gold and silver jewellery brand sold via shopnek.com. Jar reached profitability in 2025 after backing from Tiger Global, Arkam Ventures, Rainfall Ventures, Yes VC, and others at a $300M+ valuation, and is preparing for an IPO. There is no public developer API, SDK, or partner integration program — Jar is a B2C consumer mobile app distributed exclusively through Apple App Store and Google Play.

providers.name: CleanCapital
providers.description: CleanCapital is a New York based clean energy investment firm, founded in 2015, that develops, constructs, acquires, owns and operates distributed-generation solar and energy storage projects across the United States. It concentrates on the commercial and municipal middle market between residential rooftop and utility-scale generation, selling power to businesses, schools, nonprofits, municipalities and community solar subscribers, and it buys operating and late-stage development projects from developers through a dedicated project-acquisition practice. The firm reports more than $1.5 billion of capital deployed, 450+ MW under management, 235 MW developed and constructed, 200+ energy customers and over 1,000 GWh of emissions-free generation, backed by institutional partners including Manulife Investment Management / John Hancock, BlackRock and CarVal Investors. CleanCapital is an asset owner and investment manager rather than a software vendor: it publishes no developer portal, no API documentation and no machine-readable API contract, and its customer portal at app.cleancapital.com now redirects to the third-party Dock Energy platform.

providers.name: Crater Studios
providers.description: Crater Studios is an AI-native game studio that builds core AI systems for game design, decision making, and live operations, trained on real player behavior in production environments. The company uses its own live game launches as production laboratories, shipping titles such as Dwarven Realms, Gravebound, and Doomspire on Steam while building agentic tooling around them - a GDD Maker that turns raw concepts into production-ready game design documents, a conversational decision engine wired to live telemetry, automated playtesting agents, content moderation, and localization. Crater publishes a set of playable browser prototypes on craterstudios.ai subdomains as proof that its design agents can produce working core loops. Surfaced as an a16z portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass Crater Studios publishes no public API, developer portal, documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable specification - its AI systems are internal platform infrastructure rather than a developer product.

providers.name: Disrupt
providers.description: Disrupt Technology Venture is a Bangkok, Thailand-based organization focused on building the country's startup ecosystem and developing future-ready business leaders through education, executive training, and venture investment. Its offerings include the House of Talents (HOT) executive leadership curriculum, the Advanced Executive Program (AXP), corporate in-house training, and the Disrupt MBA online course platform, alongside investment vehicles such as the Disrupt Health Impact Fund (deep-tech healthcare) and the Stormbreaker edtech startup accelerator. Disrupt reports 1,500+ program alumni, 20+ corporate clients (including KBank, PTT, Unilever, and Central Group), and that 7 of the top 10 Thai startups count Disrupt alumni among their founders. This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. Disrupt publishes no public developer or API surface at this time.

providers.name: Estateguru
providers.description: Estateguru is a pan-European property-backed crowdfunding and P2P lending platform headquartered in Tallinn, Estonia. Founded in 2013, it connects retail and institutional investors with short-to-medium-term business loans secured by registered mortgages on real estate, operating across Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania, Finland, Germany, Spain and Portugal. The platform has facilitated over EUR 935 million in funding for 150,000+ investors from more than 100 countries and holds an EU ECSPR crowdservice-provider licence. Estateguru operates as a consumer investment product through its website and iOS/Android mobile apps; it publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI definition, SDKs, or agent surface. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead of Speedinvest and enriched with its genuinely published company link properties.

providers.name: Lazard
providers.description: Lazard is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Lazard API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: PIN
providers.description: PIN (getpin.xyz) is a fintech platform that makes it easy to launch and operate an investment club or syndicate, handling the administrative, legal, and tax work for group startup investments so a community can pool capital and invest in VC-backed startups together. Members onboard in a few simple steps, commit to deals, vote, and PIN manages the tax filings and portfolio support for the lifecycle of the club. PIN is venture-backed by Initialized, NEA, Industry Ventures and others. As of this enrichment pass PIN publishes only a marketing site and a member web app (app.getpin.xyz); no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDK, or /.well-known discovery surface was found.

providers.name: Cega
providers.description: Cega is a decentralized exotic derivatives protocol building on-chain structured products for investors: exotic options such as Fixed Coupon Notes (pure options and bond + options) and Dual Currency Swaps that generate yield with built-in downside protection. Cega is live on Ethereum Mainnet and Arbitrum One (EVM) and on Solana, and exposes its protocol to developers through first-party TypeScript SDKs on npm (@cega-fi) plus a GraphQL subgraph rather than a hosted REST API. Backed by Pantera Capital and surfaced into the API Evangelist network from its VC portfolio.

providers.name: Fidelity National Information Services (FIS)
providers.description: Fidelity National Information Services (FIS) is a global provider of financial services technology offering solutions across retail and institutional banking, payments, asset and wealth management, risk and compliance, and outsourcing. FIS exposes APIs to financial institutions, fintechs, and corporates through its Code Connect API marketplace.

providers.name: MultiLynq
providers.description: MultiLynq is a fixed income trading technology company founded in 2018 by Patrick Scheideler and Scott Collins and based in Shrewsbury, New Jersey. It sells market integration as a service: a single high-performance API that normalizes the messaging and trading protocols of every major and emerging electronic U.S. fixed income trading venue — including MarketAxess, Tradeweb, Trumid, Bloomberg, ICE Bonds, LTX by Broadridge, Liquidnet, Octaura, TMC Bonds and Bonds.com — into one interface for credit, municipal bond and loan trading. The platform covers pre- and post-trade workflows including price dissemination, market data aggregation, RFQ negotiation, portfolio trading, auction mechanisms, quoting conventions, smart order routing, and post-trade reporting and reconciliation, delivered as a fully hosted solution in which clients establish a single physical connection to a MultiLynq data center while MultiLynq maintains all upstream venue connectivity. The company has raised funding from Citadel Securities and Jane Street. The API is the entire product, but it is sold and onboarded through a sales conversation: MultiLynq publishes no public developer portal, documentation, specification, SDK or pricing.

providers.name: Comerica
providers.description: Comerica Incorporated is a Texas-headquartered super-regional financial services holding company providing retail, small-business, commercial, and wealth-management banking across the United States, with market concentrations in Texas, California, Michigan, Arizona, and Florida. As of July 2026 Comerica publishes NO first-party developer API portal: developer.comerica.com, api.comerica.com, and related developer subdomains do not resolve, and directory trackers (Open Banking Tracker, API Tracker) list no documented API products, OpenAPI/Swagger specs, SDKs, or Postman collections. Consumer and small-business account data is reached indirectly through US open-finance aggregators (Plaid, MX, Finicity, Akoya) and through Financial Data Exchange (FDX) APIs — the CFPB-recognized standard-setting body for the Section 1033 Personal Financial Data Rights rule — rather than a Comerica-published endpoint. Commercial treasury, cash-positioning, ACH/wire initiation, and reporting are delivered through Comerica's Cash Management and Commercial Information Management platforms under direct customer contract (host-to-host files, portal, and BAI/ISO 20022 feeds), not a public REST API. Note: Fifth Third Bancorp completed its all-stock acquisition of Comerica in February 2026, so Comerica's future digital and API surface is being integrated into Fifth Third's platform.

providers.name: Latent Space
providers.description: Latent Space is an artificial intelligence company building generative models for businesses and creatives, described by General Catalyst as creating "AI technology for predictive analytics and data-driven insights." The company raised a Series A from Greylock and General Catalyst and is listed in the General Catalyst portfolio under the Artificial Intelligence industry in North America. As of a July 2026 probe, Latent Space publishes no developer surface: the company domain latentspace.co returns an HTTP 302 redirect to its X/Twitter profile for every path probed, no docs/api/developer/app/status subdomains resolve in DNS, there are no /.well-known/ discovery documents, no llms.txt, and no public repositories under its GitHub organization. This profile therefore records verified company identity and domain posture only — no API, SDK, or documentation artifacts exist to harvest.

providers.name: Market Vibe
providers.description: MarketVibe (marketvibe.com) is a finance and technology news blog that publishes ongoing coverage under the tagline "The Financial Status of the World" — market trends, startup funding, and developer-focused technology news (for example, recurring roundups of Replit funding talks, feature releases, and AI developments). It is a WordPress.com / Newspack-hosted publication organized into Tech, Finance, and Lifestyle categories, offering articles and an RSS feed rather than a developer API product. It was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio lead and added to the API Evangelist network; enrichment found a content/media site with no product API surface (only the default WordPress REST API at /wp-json/).

providers.name: NXTP
providers.description: NXTP is an early-stage B2B technology venture capital firm investing across Latin America and globally, with more than 15 years of investing experience. Originally added to the API Evangelist network as "NXTPLabs" — a portfolio lead of 500 Global — enrichment revealed nxtplabs.com now redirects to nxtp.vc, the firm's current home. NXTP runs Fund III ($100M), has made 122 investments with 32 exits, and its portfolio companies have raised more than $2.3B in capital. The firm backs category-defining B2B founders from offices in Buenos Aires, São Paulo, and Mexico City. As an investment firm it publishes no public API, developer platform, SDK, or technical documentation, so this profile carries identity and firm facts rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Octavewealth
providers.description: Octave Wealth (octavewealth.com) is a Y Combinator-backed company that, based on its name and branding, operates in the wealth and personal-finance space. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Y Combinator and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As of this enrichment pass the company's public web presence sits behind Cloudflare and exposes no public developer API, documentation, OpenAPI specification, or SDK surface; the only machine-discoverable artifact found was a published RFC 9116 security.txt with a security contact. This profile records that verifiable state rather than a developer program.

providers.name: Timetric
providers.description: Timetric was a London-based data platform founded in 2008 for publishing, analysing, and performing calculations on large quantities of time-varying statistical data, later providing online market data, analysis, and advisory services to the insurance, construction, and infrastructure sectors. The Timetric Platform exposed an API with OAuth and API-token authentication for creating and updating time series. Timetric was acquired by GlobalData in March 2018 and timetric.com now redirects to globaldata.com; the company no longer operates independently.

providers.name: Kayum
providers.description: Kayum (KAYUM, S.A.P.I. de C.V.) is a Mexico City-based insurance data-analytics and software company serving the Mexican insurance market. It gives insurers exclusive, continuously updated market intelligence and actionable analysis: monthly price panels for GMM (major-medical), Life, and Auto lines backed by data from more than ten leading insurers, competitive pricing models, a quotation-processing tool (Claveteador) that compresses quote data preparation from days to minutes, customer-facing quoting platforms (Cotizadores) processing over 100,000 auto quotes a month, and compliance/document verification tooling (Suite 492 / ID Documental). Backed by 500 Global. The company publishes a marketing website but no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Novus (SEI Investments)
providers.description: SEI Novus (Novus) is the portfolio intelligence and analytics platform of SEI Investments, serving institutional investors — asset owners, pension funds, endowments, foundations, and family offices — with manager monitoring, exposure and performance analytics, risk assessment, and reporting across public and private market portfolios. It is an enterprise, client-login product accessed at alpha.novus.com; it exposes no public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface. Originally an independent portfolio-analytics company (novus.com), it was acquired by SEI Investments.

providers.name: Panta
providers.description: Panta is an AI-native commercial insurance brokerage that automates the operations layer of insurance placement. Rather than selling software to brokers, Panta operates as a licensed broker (all 50 states) whose AI operators handle submissions, follow-ups, service, and renewals across file systems, carrier portals, email, phone, and PDFs. It focuses on hard-to-place Excess & Surplus (E&S) and heavy-industry risk — construction and trades, transportation and logistics (trucking fleets, owner-operators, cargo), manufacturing, and hospitality — placing coverage across General Liability, Workers Compensation, Commercial Auto, Property, Cyber, Professional Liability, Umbrella/Excess, and Employment Practices Liability through an A-rated carrier panel. Surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company. Panta publishes no public API or developer platform.

providers.name: UnifiedCRM
providers.description: UnifiedCRM is a Seedcamp-backed startup (2023 investment) building a unified sales hub for remote and hybrid teams — an AI-assisted CRM delivered as a web app and PWA at unifiedcrm.ai, with features observed in the application such as email processing, deal summarization, contact and company enrichment, and automated web research. The company currently publishes no public developer API, documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable specifications.

providers.name: Basis Set Ventures
providers.description: Basis Set Ventures is an AI-native, early-stage venture capital firm founded in 2017 by Dr. Lan Xuezhao and headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area. The firm invests at the seed and early stages in founders building artificial intelligence across AI infrastructure, autonomous systems, molecular and materials discovery, agentic development tooling, intelligent collaboration, and automated workflows. Basis Set announced a $250M Fund IV and describes itself as "the first capital when it's just you and your vision," pairing capital with an operator-led founder concierge team. Portfolio companies include Path Robotics, Quince, Sakana AI, Tigris Data, Mem0, OpenArt, Cusp, Simular, Vizcom, and Entire. This is an API Evangelist network profile of the firm; Basis Set Ventures does not publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs, so this record captures firm identity, web properties, and derived security posture rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Bowery Capital
providers.description: Bowery Capital is a B2B-focused venture capital firm that leads Pre-Seed and Seed rounds in founders "modernizing business through technology." It concentrates on SaaS and marketplace companies, with particular interest in vertical AI and back-office software, and takes lead-investor positions that it supports hands-on through four pillars: Growth (go-to-market and sales enablement), Talent (hiring, culture, and benefits), Business Development (pipeline and customer introductions), and a Revenue Council advisory network of operators. Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Foundry Group. Bowery Capital is an investor rather than an API provider and publishes no developer API surface.

providers.name: K9 Ventures
providers.description: K9 Ventures is a technology-focused Pre-Seed venture capital fund based in Palo Alto, California, founded by Manu Kumar (its "Chief Firestarter"). The firm provides the first institutional capital to companies at "frighteningly early" stages, backing new core technologies, technology platforms, and new markets rather than following a fixed sector thesis. K9 makes only a handful of concentrated investments each year, favoring teams building something genuinely new. Notable past portfolio companies include Twilio, Lytro, CrowdFlower, and DNAnexus. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Foundry Group and added to the API Evangelist network; K9 Ventures does not publish a public API surface.

providers.name: Raymond James Financial
providers.description: Raymond James Financial is a diversified financial services holding company headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, providing investment banking, wealth management, capital markets, asset management, and banking services to individuals, corporations, and municipalities. With more than 7,100 financial advisors serving approximately 3 million client accounts and total client assets exceeding $637 billion, Raymond James is a Fortune 500 firm and one of the largest independent broker-dealers in the United States. The company offers client-facing portals and mobile apps for account management and reporting but does not publish a general-purpose public developer API or machine-readable specification at this time.

providers.name: Redesign Health
providers.description: Redesign Health is a global venture and applied technology firm that backs and builds next-generation healthcare companies. Founded in 2018, it partners with founders and existing businesses through AI-native venture capital and buyout strategies, and reports having touched more than 15 million patient lives while raising over $1.5 billion in capital. The firm operates from New York, Los Angeles, Riyadh, and Bengaluru. Redesign Health surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of General Catalyst; this profile captures its public identity. Redesign Health publishes no public developer API, developer portal, documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: SignalFire
providers.description: SignalFire is a venture capital firm headquartered in San Francisco that manages approximately $3 billion in assets and operates more like a tech company than a traditional VC. The firm invests across eight sectors — Health and PharmaTech, Enterprise AI, Cybersecurity, Fintech, Consumer, Applied AI/ML and Vertical SaaS, AI/ML Infrastructure and Developer Tools, and Enterprise Infrastructure and Developer Tools — and supports portfolio founders with a team of engineers, data scientists, operators, recruiters, and advisors. SignalFire's differentiator is Beacon AI, a proprietary data platform the firm spent roughly a decade building that tracks more than 80 million companies and 650 million employees across hundreds of billions of data points to power sourcing, talent, and go-to-market intelligence for both the firm and its portfolio. SignalFire does not publish any public developer APIs — Beacon AI is an internal platform offered as a service to portfolio companies, not a third-party product.

providers.name: Unshackled Ventures I
providers.description: Unshackled Ventures is an inception-stage venture capital firm that writes the first check for founders before they have products, traction, or revenue, with a focus on immigrant and international founders.
